prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Prompt:

Crea un póster vertical 9:16 de diseño editorial para transformar un nombre en cuatro estilos de firma.

【Nombre】{ej. Lucía Márquez}  
【Color superior】{terracota / azul cobalto / oliva / ciruela / ocre}

Parte superior ~40%: fondo de color suave y poco saturado, textura sutil de papel y sombra natural de ventana. Texto pequeño: “DEL NOMBRE A LA FIRMA”. En el centro muestra 【Nombre】 en tipografía sans serif moderna y legible; debajo, el mismo nombre en MAYÚSCULAS con amplio espaciado. Respeta exactamente tildes, ñ y caracteres especiales.

Parte inferior ~60%: papel marfil cálido, dividido en una cuadrícula 2×2 con líneas discontinuas muy suaves. Diseña cuatro firmas negras claramente diferentes para el mismo nombre:

FLUIDA — larga, continua, elegante, con un trazo final extendido.  
AFILADA — angular, rápida, con diagonales, cruces y trazos altos.  
LAZO — crea un gran lazo a partir de una letra real del nombre, como g, y, j o q; no añadas un óvalo decorativo.  
MARCA — versión mínima y abstracta basada en las iniciales y 4–6 trazos principales, como una firma-monograma personal.

Permite unir, reducir, superponer o abstraer letras. Las cuatro firmas deben diferenciarse claramente en silueta, ritmo y personalidad.

Usa tinta negra realista de bolígrafo o pluma, con presión natural y ligeras irregularidades. Estética sofisticada, minimalista y editorial española contemporánea.

Sin marcas de agua, números, bordes gruesos, estrellas, corazones, flores, coronas, escudos ni elementos decorativos innecesarios.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Prompt:

Create a 9:16 experimental fashion editorial poster with a realistic young adult subject inside a complete 3D spatial capture volume.

Use a clean modern architectural setting with one dominant material system and one strong subject color.

Keep the subject stylish, loose, and expressive, with a clear editorial pose and believable photography.

Build the volume with thin white edges, real front and back depth, natural body occlusion, and one key spatial mechanism:

a fluted translucent plane for optical refraction,
layered translucent planes for parallax,
typography wrapped across the volume surfaces,
or an angled semi-mirror plane for reflection.

Add one oversized English title that feels embedded in the space, plus one medium Chinese title and one short concept sentence.

No logos, top-left branding blocks, fake magazine labels, issue numbers, random microcopy, or decorative filler.

The final result should feel like a real fashion editorial poster where the subject, architecture, typography, and material system all exist in the same physical space.

prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】：填写活动 / 品牌主题
【主标题】：填写 2–6 个汉字
【副标题】：填写一句简短说明
【英文标题】：填写英文辅助标题
【古画内容】：山水 / 花鸟 / 雅集 / 园林 / 古籍等
【辅助元素】：花枝 / 茶器 / 香炉 / 书卷等
【时间地点】：填写活动信息
【主色调】：米白、茶褐、烟灰、矿物绿等
【画面比例】：9:16

设计一张宋式美学东方文化海报，将古画、书法与现代编辑排版结合。使用温暖米白宣纸背景，带细腻纸张纤维、轻微颗粒和真实印刷质感，保留大面积留白，整体安静、克制、雅致。

主标题使用有书卷气的宋体或自然书法字，可适度放大、竖排或从画面边缘裁切；顶部加入浅灰褐色超大英文衬线标题，作为背景层级。正文和时间地点使用细宋体，信息集中排列，层级清晰。

将原创【古画内容】处理成局部视觉，通过圆形、半圆、长卷、山形轮廓或毛笔飞白进行裁切，占画面约 20%–40%，不要铺满背景。加入一处【辅助元素】和少量朱砂红印章或日期点缀。

整体呈现博物馆展览邀请函、文化出版物与高端东方品牌海报的质感。避免满版古画、复杂传统纹样、元素堆砌、密集小字、乱码、廉价复古滤镜和普通国风模板感。

prompts.text:
GPT IMAGE2 提示词：
9:16 竖版，真实前置摄像头随手抓拍 × 清冷梦核 × INS 居家写真 × 轻复古手机质感。

一位 18–20 岁、明确成年的漂亮东亚女性，身高约 1.70 米，拥有纤细修长的身材比例，小头、小脸，肩颈纤细舒展，腰身纤细。胸部视觉约为自然 E 罩杯，丰满但不过度夸张，与整体纤细身材自然协调。

人物拥有真实东亚女性真人脸，精致小巧的窄鹅蛋脸、流畅下颌线与微尖下巴，五官清冷柔和，眼睛大小自然。肌肤非常白皙、细腻、通透，呈干净明亮的冷白瓷肌色调，带淡淡自然粉润血色，同时保留真实毛孔与细微皮肤纹理。

乌黑或深棕色长发柔顺自然，发量浓密，可自然披散或采用松弛简单的居家发型。少量碎发自然停留在脸侧，但不遮挡眼睛和主要五官。

人物身穿休闲日常风短款深 V 领上衣，采用明显的大深 V 低领设计，V 型领口自然向下延伸，展现肩颈、锁骨与较多上胸线条，自然呈现 E 罩杯视觉；短款衣长自然露出部分纤细腰腹。整体服装以奶油白、浅灰、低饱和粉或柔蓝色为主，简洁、柔软、生活化。

人物姿态自然松弛，可坐在床边、沙发或柔软地毯上，身体轻微侧转，上半身自然抬起。一只手可轻搭腿侧、床面或整理头发，另一只手自然放松，避免刻意商业摆拍。

采用明显的高位俯拍视角，摄影机位于人物前上方约 45–60°，从上向下拍摄。人物从较低位置微微抬起小巧的脸看向镜头，形成自然的俯视互动关系。

采用 9:16 近距离半身构图，从完整头顶拍摄至腰胯附近，人物占画面约 75%–85%，完整保留头顶、真人面容、双肩、锁骨、深 V 上衣、双臂主要部分与腰线。避免过度俯拍造成头大身小。

背景为简洁生活化室内空间，可见奶油白床品、浅色墙面、窗帘、沙发或少量家具轮廓。构图略微倾斜、不完全居中，留白稍微不均匀，模拟临时拿起手机随手记录的一瞬间。

整体采用高清人物主体 + 低清梦核手机色彩语言：人物眼睛、面部、皮肤和发丝保持清晰，通过低对比、轻微曝光、柔和 Bloom、少量细腻颗粒和边缘柔化营造早期手机影像感，而不真正降低人物清晰度。

整体色调以冷白、高级灰、奶油色与低饱和浅粉/柔蓝为主，人物露出的脸部和肌肤出现轻微柔和高光溢出，呈现清冷、慵懒、松弛、自然的 INS 随手抓拍氛围。

负面提示词： 未成年外观，儿童化面容，动漫脸，CG脸，大头，大脸，圆脸，胸部过度夸张，V领过浅，高领，长款上衣完全遮腰，严重俯拍畸变，严重广角畸变，头发遮脸，手挡脸，衣物穿模，塑料皮肤，过度磨皮，肤色偏黄，严重过曝，真正低分辨率，严重失焦，重噪点，多余肢体，多手多指，背景杂乱，文字，Logo，水印。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
通用提示词：

【品牌名】：填写
【英文名】：填写
【餐饮品类】：填写
【品牌定位】：填写
【主打菜品】：填写
【五连图内容】：填写5项
【套餐名称及价格】：填写
【推荐菜】：填写6项
【新鲜事主题】：填写
【主色调】：填写
【辅助色与点缀色】：填写
【材质与视觉风格】：填写
【画面比例】：3:4竖版

请为以上餐饮品牌生成一张“大众点评商户通装修物料概览案板”，用于前期视觉提案、客户确认和作品集展示。

画面一次性包含6类物料：
入口图、五连图、套餐图、推荐菜、菜单图、新鲜事图。

左侧设置一条窄竖栏，按顺序清晰标注：
入口图 / 五连图 / 套餐图 / 推荐菜 / 菜单图 / 新鲜事图。

顶部由品牌入口主视觉和独立案例信息卡组成。信息卡可包含：
“大众点评商户通物料视觉设计案例”
“RESTAURANT VISUAL SYSTEM”
以及品牌名、餐饮品类和年份等少量信息。

每类物料都要具备独立背景、清晰边界、完整构图和适当间距，可以单独拆分使用。菜品、装饰和背景元素不要跨越相邻模块，也不要与上下物料粘连。

整套视觉通过统一的品牌配色、字体、菜品摄影、器皿、边框、标签和装饰语言保持一致。各模块可以采用不同构图，但必须明显属于同一个餐饮品牌。

入口图突出品牌名、核心标题和主打菜；
五连图展示5个招牌菜或核心卖点；
套餐图突出套餐名称、价格和完整组合；
推荐菜用统一产品卡展示6道菜；
菜单图制作成独立的横向必点清单；
新鲜事图用于新品上市、季节限定或近期活动。

菜品使用真实、精致、有食欲感的商业餐饮摄影。食材纹理清楚，光线、器皿和场景符合品牌定位。主菜突出，辅助菜品层次明确，避免所有菜品大小和构图完全相同。

控制中文信息量，每个模块只保留主标题、简短菜名、价格和少量标签。确保缩略图状态下仍能快速识别核心内容。

避免：模块粘连、元素跨界、风格分散、背景混乱、菜品重复、摄影光线不统一、过多小字、中文乱码、廉价模板感、过度拥挤和装饰堆砌。

最终生成一张高完成度、可拆分、可继续细化的大众点评商户通餐饮视觉概览案板。确认整体风格后，再按平台规格拆分各个板块逐张完善。

prompts.text:
提示词：

【自然现象】：____
【核心汉字】：____
【作品标题】：____
【英文标题】：____
【运动规律】：____
【主色】：深靛蓝 / 灰蓝 / ____
【强调色】：朱砂红
【作品短句】：____
【比例】：9:16

生成一张 Contemporary Asian Editorial Design 风格的文化展览海报。

先提炼【自然现象】最独特的运动规律，再让这个规律直接决定构图。不要只画现象本身。

以巨大的【核心汉字】作为第一视觉，并让汉字真正参与运动：被轨迹环绕、被力量穿过、被雨痕冲刷、被光影切割、从负空间显现，或根据主题重新设计更合适的关系。

统一使用暖象牙艺术纸、深靛蓝 / 灰蓝大色形、极少朱砂节点；中文采用现代高对比宋体，英文使用 Serif，小型观察信息使用 Grotesk / Monospace。

加入少量与主题有关的时间、方向、距离、角度、强度或环境记录，作为第三层细节。信息密度中高但杂而不乱，保留约 20% 有效留白。

同系列统一纸张、字体、色彩与信息系统，但每张根据不同【运动规律】重新设计构图，不做模板换字。

第一眼看到核心力量，第二眼看到运动路径，第三眼发现观察信息，最后阅读作品标题与短句。

避免：普通风景海报、天气 App、科技 HUD、模板文字、满版书法、随机小字、Logo、编号、二维码和无意义装饰。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Prompt:

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Food / Drink: [PRODUCT]
Headline: [1 SHORT WORD]
Physical Interaction: [SWIRL / FILL / PIPE / PULL / other physical action]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Product Name: [PRODUCT NAME]
Price: [PRICE]
Aspect Ratio: 9:16

Create a premium editorial food poster where real food physically interacts with oversized typography, using a warm cream or ivory background, bold black Heavy Grotesk type, photorealistic food materials, generous negative space, and a broken editorial grid inspired by contemporary food branding and high-end magazine design.

The physical relationship must be the main visual idea, not decoration, food and typography should visibly affect each other through believable material behavior, force, flow, pressure, elasticity, or construction.

Examples: SWIRL, thick food or liquid creates a real vortex and drags nearby typography through the same rotational flow; FILL, liquid physically enters hollow letter structures and settles according to gravity and a shared liquid level; PIPE, edible material is extruded directly into missing typographic strokes and physically constructs the letters; PULL, elastic food is stretched between opposing forces and the typography deforms according to the same real tension.

Use only one physical mechanism per poster, keep cause and effect instantly readable, all deformation must follow real physics rather than random digital distortion, untouched typography should remain clean, geometric, strong, and legible.

Build the composition with asymmetric placement, strong scale contrast, edge information, small meaningful annotations, and large areas of negative space, add details such as [INGREDIENTS], [OPENING HOURS], [ADDRESS], and [PRODUCT NOTES], avoid traditional menu rows, rigid bottom information bars, long horizontal separators, boxed prices, or template-like layouts.

Use bold Grotesk Sans Serif for the main headline, high-contrast Editorial Serif or Italic Serif for product names, quotes, and prices, keep the palette minimal with cream, black, natural food colors, and one accent color.

The final poster should feel clever, physical, premium, contemporary, and immediately readable at thumbnail size, the first glance should reveal the food and headline, the second glance should reveal the physical interaction behind the design.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【品牌名称】：{例如：尾巴日和}  
【英文名称】：{例如：TAIL & DAY PET CLUB}  
【品牌类型】：{例如：宠物生活方式品牌 / 花店 / 餐饮 / 书店}  
【品牌关键词】：{例如：温暖、自然、亲切、手作感}  
【核心视觉意象】：{例如：尾巴、太阳、宠物陪伴}  
【主色建议】：{例如：奶油黄、深棕、砖红、鼠尾草绿}  
【顶部背景色】：{根据品牌气质填写}  
【画幅比例】：9:16

请为以上品牌生成一张完整的「Brand to Logo」品牌 Logo 概念探索设计稿。核心不是简单生成四个相似 Logo，而是围绕同一个品牌名称、行业属性和核心概念，提出四条真正不同的视觉设计路线。

最终画面固定为 9:16 竖版。顶部品牌输入区严格占整个画面高度的 30%，底部 Logo 展示区严格占 70%，无论品牌名称长短都不能改变这个比例；名字较长时缩小字号，不扩大顶部区域。底部 70% 再严格划分为 2×2 四个等大区域，只使用非常浅、非常细的虚线分隔，不绘制外围边框。

【顶部品牌区】

顶部只是品牌原始信息的引入区，不是主视觉海报。使用【顶部背景色】，加入极轻微的纸张、和纸、包装纸、丝网印刷颗粒或与品牌相关的低对比暗纹，只增加质感，不形成复杂插画。

顶部只保留三层信息：

BRAND TO LOGO

【品牌名称】

【英文名称】

品牌名称使用正常、清晰、现代的印刷字体，不提前进行 Logo 化、手写化或图形变形。不要加入口号、品牌说明、大量小英文、编号、印章、辅助图标或复杂光影，让视觉重点自然落到下方四个 Logo 方案。

【底部 Logo 展示区】

底部统一使用 Warm Ivory 暖米白纸张背景，只保留轻微天然纸纹。四个 Logo 都需要围绕【品牌类型】【品牌关键词】【核心视觉意象】展开，保持品牌核心一致，但设计方法必须明显不同。

每个 Logo 都应该是一套完整、可以真实用于门店、包装、标签、社交头像、名片或周边商品的品牌标识，而不是完整插画、海报或装饰图。

每个方案控制在 1–3 个主要颜色以内，优先使用【主色建议】。避免高饱和杂色、复杂渐变、3D、金属浮雕、玻璃质感和商业 mockup。

【Mascot｜吉祥物型】

从品牌名称、行业或核心意象中设计一个高度概括的角色或拟人化主体。角色需要拥有清楚的大轮廓和强记忆点，但不要做成复杂动漫人物或完整场景插画。

让角色本身与品牌概念发生关系，例如抱着产品、隐藏在物体后面、与核心植物或动物融合。搭配完整的【品牌名称】字标和较小的【英文名称】，整体亲和、有故事感、适合社交传播。

【Emblem｜意象徽章型】

不依赖完整人物，而是从【核心视觉意象】中提炼 2–3 个最重要的元素，组合成一个集中、平衡、容易缩小识别的品牌徽章。

优先使用负空间、环绕、上下叠合、局部包围或图形共形，让不同元素真正融合成一个标志，而不是简单把几个小图标并排放在一起。搭配品牌字标，形成完整稳定的 Logo 系统。

【Type-led｜字形创意型】

以【品牌名称】本身作为核心设计对象。分析中文字或英文字母中最有视觉潜力的笔画、结构、偏旁、负空间和字母轮廓，让品牌的核心意象从文字内部自然生长出来。

可以进行省笔、共享笔画、延长、切割、局部替换、负空间重构或字形融合，但必须保留基本识别度。

不要在普通字体旁边额外贴一个图标。重点是让“文字本身就是 Logo”，形成更现代、更聪明、更具有专业平面设计感的方案。

【Stamp｜开放式手作印记型】

设计一款具有手刻、版画、店章或包装印记气质的 Logo，但不要使用规整完整的方框，也不要把所有内容塞进封闭椭圆。

使用不完整边界、开放弧线、自然笔触、品牌核心图形或文字共同形成松散的视觉范围。元素可以轻微错位，边缘允许少量自然缺墨和手工印刷不均，让整体具有呼吸感。

Stamp 必须保持清楚的主次关系和充分留白。不要因为追求“印章感”而变得死板、密集或难以实际使用。

四款必须共享同一个品牌世界观、核心意象和基础配色，但不能只是同一个 Logo 换四种画风或四种排版。

不要加入 A/B/C/D 等编号。底部不要添加口号、解释句或多余信息。不要生成包装 mockup、真实门店场景或完整插画。

最终画面要像一张成熟、干净、有方法差异、有真实品牌设计价值的专业 Logo Exploration Sheet。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
真是挖到宝了！！
感觉可以直接拿来接单变现！

这是我见过最规范的用AI做Logo设计的Skill ！！
一个大神设计师把品牌设计的工作流程、1400多个真实 Logo 参考，以及测试和导出工具，整理成一个 Skill。
看了一下，完全是按照专业设计流程规范来的！

先调研品牌做什么、用户是谁、想传递什么感觉，再研究同行常见的设计。
然后提出 8–12 个创意，从中挑出差异最大的三个，实际画成 SVG。
设计过程中先画黑白稿，确定轮廓和结构后再讨论颜色。
三个方案完成后，还要测试、修改，整理成一张对比图，告诉你推荐哪个、理由是什么。
等你选定方向，再继续制作完整的 Logo 套件。

更有意思的是，这套Skill会完全颠覆常规设计思路！！
比如，咖啡品牌只会画杯子，安全工具只会画盾牌、智能产品只会画大脑......
它会让 Agent 先研究参考库，把品类里用得太多的元素列出来，再探索独特性的表达。

并且完成之后，还会有自检查！
检查SVG 代码还不够，还要渲染成图片检查。
配套的脚本还会自动检查字体依赖、混入的位图、过于复杂的路径、细小到可能消失的结构等问题。
一整套流程下来，确保Logo设计的美观和规范。
最后确认之后，会输出黑白版、单色版、横版和竖版组合、Favicon、App 图标，以及简明使用指南。

作者还开源了 28 个虚构品牌的完整案例，从咖啡店到 SaaS，都能看到概念方案和选定方向的应用效果。
试了一试，确实比几句提示词生成出来的Logo设计图更加高级，关键是放大缩小都不会糊！！

完全可以应对专业场景需求！
开源地址放下面了，有兴趣可以试试！

prompts.text:
I love these popup diorama prompts. They can be done for all kinds of fun topics. 

16:9, 2x2 grid, AI picks different countries, decades RENDER_CHAIN = "[$COUNTRY :: $ DECADE_CATEGORY :: catalog_popup_diorama_grid :: 8K]"  FUSION_RULES = {     "era_lock": "infer DECADE and retail CATEGORY from $ COUNTRY + $ DECADE_CATEGORY; ALL elements (product, user clothing, room, packaging, typography) must match the same decade",     "four_gates": "household, leisure/childhood, tech/work, unusual/regional — one panel each, distinct subculture",     "per_gate_infer": "HERO_PRODUCT, TARGET_USER, ASPIRATION, ENVIRONMENT, ORDERING_RITUAL, PACKAGING, GRAPHIC_LANGUAGE, PALETTE (era-accurate)",     "companions": "exactly 5 companion products per panel; rendered at 60–75% hero scale; some 3D, some printed-only",     "fold_field": "Φ(x,y) = fold_line_pressure(FOLD_AXES) + panel_rigidity(PAGE_LAYOUT); F=∇Φ, Curl=∇×F, Div=∇·F",     "page_to_architecture": {         "PRODUCT_FRAME": "room opening (cut a window into the page)",         "COLUMN_RULES": "walls (raise paper strips along rule lines)",         "PRICE_BOX": "raised platform (fold up price rectangle)",         "PAGE_FOLD": "room corner (90° valley fold)",         "PAGE_EDGE": "sidewalk or shelf (exposed paper cross-section)",         "PERFORATION": "stair or fence (cut & fold perforation)"     },     "popup_rule": "hero product physically emerges from its printed image; scale 0.30–0.50 of panel width; real materials; 45–90° out of page; casts shadow on flat print below",     "character_rule": "2–4 tiny consumers at 1:48 or 1:64 scale, photoreal vinyl/resin, performing the ORDERING_RITUAL pose (using, assembling, admiring, ordering, receiving)",     "before_after": "FLAT_BEFORE_ZONE = printed image + halftone + catalog type; 3D_AFTER_ZONE = physical miniature + cast shadow + real material; at least one companion stays printed-only",     "ritual_layer": "render ordering clue (phone receiver, coupon envelope, perforated order slip, receipt, terminal keyboard, mail slot) at small scale on raised price platform",     "typography": "abstract blocky/script shapes evoking era retail typography; only legible text is the small label [Catalog Category | Country | Decade]",     "lighting_camera": "soft top-left key, broad bounce fill, subtle right rim; slate-gray seamless bg, 45mm, shallow DOF, 8K",     "validation": "verify 4 distinct catalog categories; verify page-to-architecture mapping; verify hero 3D emerges from 2D print; verify at least one companion remains flat; verify 2–4 era-appropriate consumers doing the ritual; verify ordering clue present; verify exactly 5 companions; verify typography abstract except label; verify no logos, no watermarks, no third-party brands" }  OUTPUT = (RENDER_CHAIN :: FUSION_RULES) - NEGATIVE_SET RENDER: ONE 8K catalog pop-up diorama grid.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
兄弟，我发现了一个特别容易出神图的海报公式。

真的不是再加几个“高级感、电影感、杂志感”这种废词。

我最近在研究这类复古海报，突然发现它最爽的地方是：

把一幅名画“拆了”，只拿走它最值钱的东西。

不是复刻《雾海上的漫游者》《睡莲》《神奈川冲浪里》，而是只提炼：

巨大英文单词 + 极小人物 + 大面积留白 + Swiss 排版 + 70 年代旧印刷质感。

一下就从“名画二创”变成了真正的概念设计海报。

提示词母版也直接送了，自己替换括号就行👇

3:4 conceptual retro editorial poster, inspired by 【名画母题/艺术流派】 but not directly reproducing it, reinterpret its composition, visual motif and emotional atmosphere as a modern conceptual poster.

Large 【cream / ivory】 negative space on aged uncoated paper, giant uppercase word “【主标题】” in 【颜色】 bold condensed sans-serif typography, interacting with the scene through fog, water, architecture or foreground elements.

Lower portion shows 【重新设计后的场景】 with a very small 【人物 / 小船 / 房子 / 物体】 as a scale anchor, creating a strong contrast between monumental typography and tiny human presence.

Swiss modernist editorial layout, tiny ISSUE / DATE / POSTER SERIES metadata, thin rule lines, small poetic quote, bottom caption and issue number.

Muted 2–4 color palette, 1970s European art magazine aesthetic, vintage offset printing, screen print texture, halftone grain, faded ink, subtle scratches, slight misregistration, aged paper fibers, matte finish.

minimal, poetic, conceptual, museum poster, elegant, restrained, quiet but visually striking.

no QR code, no watermark, no logo, no mockup, no social media overlay, no glossy commercial style, no neon cyberpunk, no 3D metallic text, no clutter
这套东西我越玩越觉得有意思。

AI 画图最怕的是“想画得漂亮”，一旦开始用设计逻辑控制它，味道马上就不一样了。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
新中式细线设色，别只拿来画古诗。我用它画了今天的城市：便利店、地铁站、老小区、深夜写字楼。

4 段提示词，一段对一张图，直接拿走。换题材只改“画的是现代城市的日常：”后面那一句。

① 便利店
新中式细线设色插画，画的是现代城市的日常：深夜街角一家亮着灯的 24 小时便利店。用工笔白描的均匀细墨线勾出玻璃门、货架、冰柜和门口的一辆共享单车，线条干净不抖。只在少数地方平涂矿物色：屋檐与招牌用石青、石绿，店内灯光用淡藤黄，门口一个小小的外卖骑手背影用一点朱砂红。其余大面积留白，像宣纸底色，微微泛暖，有极淡的纸纹。店的上方飘着两团传统画法的云纹，旁边一棵团状树冠的树，用同样的细线和青绿设色。构图偏下，上方留出三分之二的空白。不要水墨晕染，不要写实光影，不要 3D 质感。画面里不要出现任何文字、印章、logo 或水印。竖幅构图。

② 地铁站台
新中式细线设色插画，画的是现代城市的日常：早高峰的地铁站台。用工笔白描的均匀细墨线勾出站台、屏蔽门、刚进站的列车车头和一排低头看手机的候车人，线条干净不抖，人物很小。只在少数地方平涂矿物色：列车车身的腰线用石青，站台立柱用石绿，候车人群里只有一个人撑着一把朱砂红的伞。其余大面积留白，像宣纸底色，微微泛暖，有极淡的纸纹。站台上方的留白里飘着两团传统画法的云纹，仿佛屋顶不存在。构图偏下，上方留出三分之二的空白。不要水墨晕染，不要写实光影，不要 3D 质感。画面里不要出现任何文字、印章、logo 或水印。竖幅构图。

③ 老小区阳台
新中式细线设色插画，画的是现代城市的日常：傍晚的老小区阳台。用工笔白描的均匀细墨线勾出一栋六层居民楼的侧面，每层阳台上有晾衣杆、空调外机、花盆和防盗网，线条干净不抖。只在少数地方平涂矿物色：几件晾着的衣服用石青和石绿，一户窗里的灯光用淡藤黄，一只蹲在空调外机上的猫用一点朱砂红的项圈点出来。其余大面积留白，像宣纸底色，微微泛暖，有极淡的纸纹。楼旁一棵团状树冠的老树，楼顶上方飘着一团传统画法的云纹，都用同样的细线和青绿设色。构图偏下，上方留出三分之二的空白。不要水墨晕染，不要写实光影，不要 3D 质感。画面里不要出现任何文字、印章、logo 或水印。竖幅构图。

④ 深夜写字楼
新中式细线设色插画，画的是现代城市的日常：深夜还亮着灯的写字楼一角。用工笔白描的均匀细墨线勾出一座玻璃幕墙写字楼的上半截，一格一格的窗户排列整齐，线条干净不抖。只在少数地方平涂矿物色：幕墙的横向分隔带用石青、石绿，整栋楼只有三四格窗户用淡藤黄点亮，其中一格窗里有一个很小的伏案身影，桌上一只朱砂红的杯子。其余大面积留白，像宣纸底色，微微泛暖，有极淡的纸纹。楼腰处横着一带传统画法的云纹，把楼的下半截遮住，远处一弯细细的月亮。构图偏下，上方留出三分之二的空白。不要水墨晕染，不要写实光影，不要 3D 质感。画面里不要出现任何文字、印章、logo 或水印。竖幅构图。

规律就三条：细线勾形，颜色只给三四处，剩下全留白。

画法参考了 @MrLarus 的新中式古诗系列。

很明显就是冲着电商、设计这个高频场景来的！！

prompts.text:
Use our agent to turn a simple idea into a detailed video prompt. The prompt below was generated from just one sentence:
“Create an authentic 30-second personal travel vlog capturing a day in the Maldives, filmed by her boyfriend on a compact mirrorless camera or smartphone. The mood should feel warm, joyful, intimate, and cinematic. She is wearing a bikini.”

See the full conversation and complete video prompt here:：
https://promptsref.com/canvas/fd18e2ad-f4d9-40ff-bb90-568a96f6f0c5

prompt：
Create a 30-second authentic personal travel vlog documenting one joyful day in the Maldives. Vertical 9:16, warm cinematic realism, natural handheld footage filmed by her boyfriend using a compact mirrorless camera or modern smartphone. The footage should feel spontaneous, personal, and lightly imperfect rather than like a polished commercial.

Main subject: Use the characters in the reference image. an adult woman with a consistent natural appearance throughout the video, sun-kissed skin, loose windblown hair, relaxed joyful expressions, wearing the same tasteful two-piece bikini. Keep her face, hairstyle, body proportions, bikini color, and accessories consistent in every shot. Her boyfriend is behind the camera and is occasionally heard laughing or speaking naturally, but he is not shown.

0–5 seconds: Early morning at a Maldivian villa. Handheld establishing shot of turquoise water, white sand, palm leaves moving in the breeze, and sunlight reflecting on the lagoon. The camera turns toward her as she steps onto the wooden deck, smiles at the camera, and says softly, “Good morning from the Maldives.” Natural morning ambience, gentle waves, distant birds.

5–10 seconds: Follow her from behind and then move beside her as she walks barefoot along the beach, holding her linen shirt loosely. She looks back at the camera and laughs. Use a natural walking pace, slight handheld camera sway, realistic sunlight and soft lens flare. Capture footprints forming in the sand.

10–16 seconds: At the lagoon, she wades into the shallow crystal-clear water and splashes playfully toward the camera. The boyfriend reacts with a brief laugh from behind the camera. Alternate between a medium handheld shot and a close-up of water droplets, keeping the action physically believable and her face recognizable.

16–22 seconds: Late afternoon snorkeling moment. She adjusts her mask, jumps gently from a small dock, and comes back up smiling. Brief underwater glimpse of clear blue water and colorful fish, then return to a handheld shot from the dock. Preserve realistic water movement, wet hair, and consistent lighting.

22–27 seconds: Golden-hour beach picnic with fresh tropical fruit and coconut water. She sits cross-legged on a woven mat, offers a piece of fruit toward the camera, then leans against her boyfriend's shoulder just outside the frame. Warm sunset light, intimate laughter, relaxed candid energy.

27–30 seconds: Blue-hour closing shot from behind as the couple walks hand in hand along the shoreline. She turns back toward the camera and smiles. End on the ocean horizon and glowing sunset reflections, with natural waves continuing under the final frame.

Editing and style: quick but gentle vlog pacing, motivated cuts between morning, midday, afternoon, and sunset; retain natural handheld movement and occasional focus breathing; realistic skin texture, fabric movement, water physics, and changing daylight. Keep the emotional tone warm, joyful, intimate, adventurous, and cinematic without appearing staged. Use only natural ambient sound, soft ocean waves, birds, footsteps, splashing water, quiet laughter, and subtle non-diegetic acoustic music that builds gently and fades at the end. No excessive beauty retouching, no slow-motion glamour shots, no sexualized framing, no nudity, no explicit intimacy, and no readable text or logos.

prompts.text:
提示词：

【海报主题】
【主标题】
【核心大色域】
【大色域结构】
【主色调】
【微型文化场景】
【核心动作】
【文化器物】
【活动信息】
【画幅比例】
9:16 竖版

设计一张现代东方文化活动海报，以「纸纤维 + 大色域结构 + 主动留白 + 微型文化场景」为核心。

背景使用暖象牙白手工纸，保留约 45%–60% 留白。使用【核心大色域】建立第一视觉主体，并根据【大色域结构】形成纤维束、螺旋、薄片、正负形、穿插、嵌套或其他清晰的大形关系。远看先看到构图方法，近看才发现它与【海报主题】中的真实工艺或材料相关。

大色域具有明显天然纸纤维、纸浆颗粒、水彩或矿物颜料沉积、自然毛边和哑光质感。整体使用【主色调】，颜色低饱和但完整、有浓度，不做脏旧、褪色、随机斑驳、强噪点和数字渐变。

在大色域附近加入非常小的【微型文化场景】，人物正在真实完成【核心动作】，人物、工具和【文化器物】整体只占约 3%–5%，不做商品陈列。

人物统一采用二维纸本淡彩插画画法：五官极简、轻体积、完整平面色块、少量连续衣褶线，不出现摄影皮肤、3D 微缩模型感、CGI 光影、强投影或真实景深。

微场景与巨大主视觉之间加入一处真实来源的“尺度连接”，例如纤维、旋转轨迹、薄箔边缘、印迹、定位线或材料本身，让小人物正在处理的材料视觉上延展成巨大色域结构。连接必须有明确起点和终点，不漂浮、不机械重复同一种曲线。

主标题【主标题】使用小尺度现代宋体或明朝体，放在留白区域；英文类别、日期、地点和【活动信息】使用更小字号克制排版。所有文字必须具有真实意义。

整体阅读顺序为：

留白与大色域 → 大形结构 → 材料质感 → 微型文化场景 → 工艺动作 → 标题与活动信息。

最终呈现远看大形清楚、近看纸纤维丰富、有文化叙事和材料细节的现代东方编辑海报。

避免巨大标题、普通国风插画、写实人物、3D 微缩模型、摄影背景、PPT 网格、商业广告感、脏旧纸张、随机噪点、CGI、玻璃或镜面材质、Logo、水印、编号和星芒装饰。

prompts.text:
Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second Japanese action-comedy with synchronized sound. B interrupts spectacular sword combat by capturing Shibuya's giant monster with an enormous arcade claw. Its dangling legs kick helplessly. End on A's familiar silent, stunned face. Use the selected aspect ratio.

REFERENCES
A = black-haired heroine from @Image 1; voice = @Audio 1.
B = white-haired heroine from @Image 2; voice = @Audio 2.
Monster = @Image 3, approximately 100 meters tall.
Preserve exact faces, hair, costumes, accessories, proportions and reference art styles. Identity references only; no sheet layouts.
One A, one B, one monster. Allied heroines, equal standing height excluding ornaments.
Heroines remain clean-lined, cel-shaded 2D anime. Monster retains its reference style. Shibuya, claw, cable, glass, concrete, dust and reflections are photorealistic. Match scene lighting without changing illustrated faces.
VOICE
ONE spoken line. A uses @Audio 1 at 0.3–1.1s and says:
「いくよ！」
Natural Japanese pronunciation and accurate lip sync. References define voices, not scripts; never replay recordings.
B is silent; @Audio 2 is unused.
After this line: no speech, narration, screams, grunts, gasps, laughter or audible character breaths. Music and effects continue.
LOCATION AND PROPS
Rain-wet nighttime Shibuya crossing: zebra stripes, towers, neon reflections. Screens show abstract colors, no text. No civilians, traffic or extra monsters.
A fights on the near crossing; B stands on the nearby sidewalk. Monster occupies the far side between buildings. Preserve this geography and all damage.
A has one right-hand katana and one waist scabbard. Her blade never changes shape.
B stands behind a plain waist-high arcade pedestal, present from the opening. ONE joystick, ONE red button, no screen or labels. Left hand moves joystick; right index finger presses button.
Claw: one giant silver three-pronged arcade grabber, central housing and ONE taut steel cable extending upward beyond the frame. Rounded gripping ends, consistent mechanical design. Open span exceeds the monster's shoulder width.
CAPTURE RULES
Joystick aligns the claw. ONE button press triggers descent, closure and lifting.
Show the claw approaching OPEN, surrounding the upper torso, making contact, closing beneath the shoulders and THEN lifting.
Three prongs form a supporting cage around the torso without piercing, crushing or passing through it. Head, arms and legs remain visible.
The monster retains its size and design; only the dangling posture resembles a prize. No plush transformation.
Feet leave the road only after the closed claw is pulled upward by its cable. No levitation before gripping.
Once captured, it stays held and continues rising. No release or escape.
Heroines remain outside the debris path and are never captured.
0.0–4.0s — EXPLOSIVE COMBAT
Open immediately: the monster's huge beam cuts across the far road, rupturing asphalt in a traveling line of impacts.
A sprints diagonally clear of the beam, trailing teal light and water spray.
She kicks off a low facade and launches into ONE airborne sword slash.
A speaks the opening line in the specified window.
Her katana releases a broad teal-white crescent that visibly strikes the monster's torso. Brief impact slowdown, sparks and an air ring, then explosive follow-through.
Monster staggers but stays standing. Its beam stops.
A lands at the near crossing and raises her blade for another attack.
Briefly establish B beside her pedestal, calmly watching.
Fast tracking; readable silhouettes.
4.0–6.0s — THE BUTTON
Medium shot includes B's face, hands, joystick and button.
B moves the joystick once with her left hand while looking upward, aligning the claw above the monster.
Her right index finger visibly presses the red button ONCE. Ordinary arcade click; neutral expression.
Cut upward: clouds part around the enormous OPEN claw beginning its vertical descent, cable visible above it.
Button press precedes descent.
6.0–8.5s — THE CLAW DESCENDS
Low three-quarter wide view includes monster, claw and buildings.
The open claw drops between the towers. Air pressure rolls the clouds outward and drives dust along the street.
An outer prong clips an empty building corner, shearing off glass and concrete. Heavy fragments fall away from the heroines.
The claw slows near the monster. Preserve clear body and prong silhouettes.
Open prongs surround the torso, contact its sides and close beneath the shoulders in one readable movement.
A deep mechanical clunk marks the completed grip.
Show closure before lifting, without a cut hiding capture.

8.5–11.0s — AN ENORMOUS PRIZE
Cable retracts, lifting the closed claw. Show both monster feet leaving the street and loose rubble falling beneath them.
The monster hangs upright, supported beneath the shoulders, torso slightly slumped.
Both legs make short, frantic alternating kicks. Arms flail without changing anatomy. Hold a wide view long enough to read the helpless dangling posture.
As it rises, one swinging foot strikes an upper facade and breaks glass and concrete outward. Show foot contact before destruction.
Claw stays closed, cable taut; no shrinking or toy transformation.
Tilt upward with the ascent, preserving the claw and monster outlines against the clouds.
11.0–12.5s — B WINS
Medium two-shot near the crossing: A left, B right beside the pedestal.
Captured monster continues rising in the distant background, legs still kicking.
B releases the controls and gives one small satisfied right-handed fist pump.
A holds her katana ready with nothing left to fight. She looks up after the monster, then toward B. Her determined expression fades.
Keep her blade clear of B and the pedestal.
12.5–15.0s — THE FAMILIAR FACE
Frontal close-up of A, exact reference face and hairstyle.
Wide eyes, small pupils, raised brows; lips part ONCE and hold still. Her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression.
A looks toward camera; no blush, crying or scream face.
Short controlled push-in; hold the final full second with tiny natural movement. Sword outside the crop.
Damaged Shibuya remains blurred behind her. End on A, no extra gag or cut back.
CAMERA AND SOUND
Directional tracking, brief impact slowdown, wide capture framing. Blur backgrounds and debris, preserve silhouettes.
Instrumental percussion, strings and brass; no choir or vocal samples.
Synchronize combat impacts, button, winch, claw and structural damage.
Reduce dramatic music as the claw closes. Stop it when the monster's feet leave the road, revealing machinery, frantic foot impacts and falling rubble.
Final face: faint wind, distant winch and settling debris.
No monster vocals, canned laughter, comedy sting or victory announcement.
EXCLUDE
Text, subtitles, logos, watermarks, HUD, score displays, extra characters, clones, mixed identities, costume changes, extra limbs or fingers, fused bodies, morphing weapons, gore, injured heroines, changing claw geometry or monster release.

prompts.text:
MiniMax H3 Prompt
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the original character A from <Picture 1>. Preserve her exact face, hair, costume, accessories, proportions and illustrated style.
<Subject 2> is character B from <Picture 2>. Preserve her exact design and illustrated style. She holds the camera and remains silent.
<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1). Reference her vocal identity and natural pitch range without copying the recording or its words.
summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] A 15-second Japanese 2D anime comedy. <Subject 1> creates three identical clones to intimidate <Subject 2>. When <Subject 2> raises a camera, all four versions instinctively smile and make peace signs. After the shutter, the original realizes she posed too. End on her silent, stunned face with her peace sign still raised. Use the selected output aspect ratio.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - retain her identity and design. Three newly generated clones copy her appearance exactly. Reference-image backgrounds, poses and sheet layouts are not reproduced.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - retain her identity and design, with new camera-handling actions. Never duplicate her or blend the two designs.
<Audio 1>: reference - use only its voice timbre for the original's opening sentence. Never replay its recorded content.
detailed_description:
High-quality hand-drawn 2D anime with clean linework, cel shading, fluid character animation and expressive faces. A spacious stone courtyard in soft daylight; consistent lighting and character scale. No visible writing, subtitles, logos or interface graphics.

[Shot 1] A medium-wide view establishes <Subject 1> on screen-left and <Subject 2> on screen-right, facing each other about three meters apart. <Subject 1> raises her hands in a confident summoning gesture. From 0.3 to 2.8 seconds, <Subject 1> (S1), using the voice timbre from <Audio 1>, proudly declares with synchronized mouth movement, [Japanese] ほんものを、みやぶれるか! Her lips close when the sentence ends. Three identical clones materialize in separate violet wisps beside and slightly behind her. By four seconds, the wisps clear. Exactly four versions of A and one B exist. Original A remains center-front of the shallow group, with three clones staggered behind her and nobody obscured. All four face B with threatening combat stances. Hold this formation briefly; their hands are not yet making peace signs. A magical whoosh fades into quiet courtyard ambience.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, cut to a medium shot of <Subject 2>. Calm and expressionless, she brings one ordinary compact black camera from behind her hip and raises it to eye level. Her right hand grips the camera with her index finger over the shutter; her left supports it. The lens points toward the four A figures. She silently looks through the viewfinder without pressing the shutter yet. Soft clothing rustle. No request to pose.

[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, cut to an over-the-shoulder view from beside <Subject 2>'s camera, framing all four A figures clearly. Original <Subject 1> stays center-front. On noticing the lens, all four simultaneously relax their combat stances, smile and raise one peace sign beside their own cheeks. Each extends the index and middle fingers in a V, with the remaining fingers folded. Their other hands hang naturally. Show the entire change in this continuous shot, then hold the completed poses. At about ten seconds, B's visible shutter finger presses once: one crisp click and one short flash. All four are already posing before the shutter. The flash fades immediately; the scene remains moving footage. The three clones keep smiling. Only the original's smile starts to fade as she notices her own raised fingers.
[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, cut to a close-up of original <Subject 1>, including her face and raised V-sign. She glances at her fingers, then toward B. Her eyes widen, pupils become small, eyebrows rise and lips part slightly once, then hold. Her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression replaces the photo smile. No blush or exaggerated panic. Her hand stays beside her cheek. A short, slow push-in ends in a full second of still, awkward disbelief. The clones remain in place outside the close-up. End directly on the original's face and peace sign.
overall_soundscape:
Faint courtyard wind, the opening summoning whoosh, soft clothing movement, and exactly one camera shutter click. Only the original speaks the single sentence in Shot 1. B and all clones remain completely silent. After three seconds, there are no character vocal sounds: no speech, gasps, laughter, grunts or vocal breaths. If a second voice-reference file is attached for B, do not use it to generate or replay any audio. No narration, spoken countdown, crowd voices or canned laughter.
non_diegetic_music:
A restrained, tense instrumental score with low strings and light percussion accompanies the opening threat. It stops abruptly at the camera shutter. The ending contains only faint courtyard ambience. No vocals, choir, comedy sting or additional ending gag.

    infer_iconic_silhouette(:SUBJECT) AS logo,

    infer_era_typography(:SUBJECT)     AS typeface,
    infer_eight_milestones(:SUBJECT)   AS milestones,
    infer_historical_artifacts(:SUBJECT, 30) AS artifacts
),
-- ── HEADER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
header_block AS (
  SELECT
    render_typography(
      text := :SUBJECT,
      font := typeface,
      fill := primary_color,
      position := 'top'
    ) AS header
  FROM inferred
),
-- ── LOGO MASK & COLLAGE ────────────────────────────────────────
collage_block AS (
  SELECT
    render_logo_mask(inferred.logo, inferred.primary_color) AS mask,
    array_agg(
      render_halftone_artifact(a.artifact)
      ORDER BY random()
    ) AS packed_artifacts
  FROM inferred, unnest(inferred.artifacts) AS a(artifact)
  GROUP BY inferred.logo, inferred.primary_color
),
-- ── TIMELINE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
timeline_block AS (
  SELECT
    render_timeline(
      nodes := inferred.milestones,
      style := 'vintage_icon_nodes'
    ) AS timeline
  FROM inferred
),
-- ── COMPOSITE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
composite AS (
  SELECT
    compose(
      paper     := 'aged_cream',
      header    := header_block.header,
      mask      := collage_block.mask,
      artifacts := collage_block.packed_artifacts,
      timeline  := timeline_block.timeline
    ) AS poster
  FROM header_block, collage_block, timeline_block
)
-- ── FINAL RENDER ───────────────────────────────────────────────
SELECT render(composite.poster)
WITH
  style := 'vintage_screenprint_infographic',
  palette := (SELECT primary_color FROM inferred),
  resolution := '8K';
-- ── VALIDATION CHECKS ──────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. exactly 8 milestones
-- 2. collage inside logo mask
-- 3. typography top-aligned
-- 4. strictly 2-color

Prompt:

[Name]: {e.g. Amelia Rose}  
[Top Background Color]: {e.g. dusty blue, muted rose, forest green, deep burgundy, warm ochre}  
[Final Ratio]: 9:16

Create a vertical 9:16 "Name to Signature" design sheet that transforms one plain English name into four clearly different handwritten signature concepts.

Use two sections. The top 40% shows the original typed name, and the bottom 60% shows four signature designs.

For the top section, use the selected muted background color with subtle paper or fabric texture and a soft natural shadow. Add small widely spaced text at the top:

NAME TO SIGNATURE

Display the original name in the center using a large, clean neutral sans-serif font such as Helvetica, Arial, Inter, or a similar modern typeface. This must look like normal typed text, not handwriting. Keep the layout minimal and do not add extra slogans or decorative copy.

For the bottom section, use a warm ivory paper background with very subtle grain. Divide it into a clean 2×2 grid using faint thin dashed lines, with no outer border.

Create four large black handwritten signatures for the same name. They must be noticeably different in silhouette, rhythm, stroke direction, abstraction, and personality. Do not simply generate four similar cursive versions.

Use realistic gel pen or fountain pen handwriting with natural pressure variation, lighter entry strokes, stronger main strokes, tapered endings, and slight ink irregularity. Letters may merge, stretch, overlap, simplify, share strokes, or become partially abstract. The goal is signature design, not perfect letter-by-letter readability.

FLOW: Create a graceful, fluid signature with smooth connected strokes and one or two long sweeping tails. Keep it elegant, natural, and believable as a real personal signature.

EDGE: Create a sharper, more directional signature using stronger slant, tall vertical accents, pointed turns, crossings, and decisive endings. Make it modern, confident, and fashion-forward.

LOOP: Build the signature around a large expressive looping gesture. Compress parts of the name inside or across the loop, and allow one stroke to extend outward as a strong finishing motion. Keep the loop organic and handwritten rather than geometrically perfect.

MARK: Create the most minimal and abstract version. Reduce the name to approximately 4–6 important strokes, often using the initials or strongest letter shapes as the foundation. The result may resemble a personal monogram or creator mark more than fully readable handwriting.

For softer or more romantic names, MARK may be replaced with CHARM: a refined usable signature with one subtle personal detail, such as a tiny heart-like terminal or a minimal floral gesture. Keep it tasteful and mature.

The four designs must feel clearly different at first glance. FLOW should feel fluid, EDGE sharp, LOOP expressive, and MARK minimal.

Keep each signature large enough to dominate its quadrant. Do not add extra descriptions under the style labels.

Do not add watermarks, numbering, decorative borders, stars, crowns, excessive hearts, unrelated icons, or unnecessary graphic elements.

Prompt:

TITLE: [poster title]
CONCEPT WORDS: [3–4 related words]

GRAPHIC SYSTEMS: [dots / wave lines / concentric arcs / offset contours / radiating lines]
EVENT TYPE: [sound art / exhibition / live performance / cultural program]

FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a high-end experimental typography poster where oversized English words become the main visual system.

Use 3–4 layered words with clear conceptual relationships. Do not simply place normal bold text and apply textures inside it. Rebuild the letterforms directly from precise geometric systems such as dot matrices, parallel wave lines, concentric or eccentric arcs, stepped contours, offset registrations, radiating segments, and frequency-like line bundles.

Give different text layers different graphic behaviors, then connect them through controlled transitions: dots may stretch into lines, arcs may open into waves, waves may shift or drift, and line systems may gradually realign. The poster should feel like one evolving typographic field rather than several separate effects.

Use overlap, compression, partial cropping, displacement, and negative space to create dense multi-layer typography. Maintain strong density contrast: some areas highly compressed and bright, some medium-density, and some deliberately open.

Keep all dots and lines exceptionally clean, sharp, continuous, and intentional. Smooth curves, consistent spacing, clear endpoints, stable dot shapes, no accidental broken lines, fuzzy edges, random noise, messy moiré, glitch artifacts, or low-quality AI textures.

Use a restrained, high-contrast color palette with one dominant background, one main typography color, and only small accent areas.

Reserve the lower 25%–30% for a refined editorial information section with the poster title, one short concept sentence, 2–3 program items, date, time, venue, and program name. Use clean modern sans-serif typography, multiple hierarchy levels, thin divider lines, and an asymmetric cultural-poster grid.

The final image should work at three distances: a strong abstract composition at thumbnail size, readable layered typography at medium distance, and rich geometric detail up close.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【中文姓名】：{例如：林知夏}  
【姓名拼音】：{例如：LIN ZHIXIA}  
【顶部背景色】：{例如：深钴蓝、灰调珊瑚、鼠尾草绿、深酒红}  
【画幅比例】：9:16

请将输入的普通中文姓名重新设计成一张完整的「中文个性签名 AI Filter」设计稿。最终画面为 9:16 竖版，上方约占 40%，展示普通印刷姓名；下方约占 60%，展示同一个名字的四种完全不同的艺术手写签名。整体高级、克制、现代、有专业设计提案感，不要像普通字体样张或书法练习纸。

【顶部姓名区】

使用【顶部背景色】作为主色，加入极轻微的纸张或织物质感，并可加入柔和自然的窗影、树影或建筑光影，但不要复杂。顶部中央使用很小、字距宽松的英文“NAME TO SIGNATURE”，中央使用暖象牙白色、规整优雅的中文宋体大字展示【中文姓名】，姓名下方以小字号、宽字距大写英文显示【姓名拼音】。

这里的中文姓名必须保持普通印刷字体，不要手写、连笔或艺术变形，用来明确表现“原始输入”。除此之外不要添加额外标语、解释文案、Logo、编号或装饰图形，保持充分留白，让姓名成为上半部分绝对视觉中心。

【底部签名区】

底部统一使用暖米白色纸张，只保留非常轻微的天然纸纹，不做明显做旧、污渍或强颗粒。使用非常浅、非常细的灰褐色虚线将区域分成 2×2 四格，不需要外边框。每一格只展示一个大尺寸黑色艺术签名，以及下方很小的风格名称：飘逸、锋势、回环、极简。

四个签名全部来源于同一个【中文姓名】，但在结构、方向、节奏、抽象程度、重心和视觉人格上必须有明显差异。不要只是将完整姓名用四种相似连笔方式重新写一遍。允许大胆省笔、合笔、共享笔画、连续连写、拉长、缩写、重构和符号化，不要求每个中文字都完整可辨，重点是从姓名中提炼具有个人识别度的签名结构。

签名使用自然黑色签字笔、钢笔或 gel pen 的真实手写质感，线条带自然笔压变化：起笔较细，主笔略重，转折处有自然压力，快速拖尾逐渐变细，局部允许极轻微断墨。不要生成完全光滑的数字矢量曲线，也不要做成传统毛笔书法。

【飘逸款】

将姓名设计成横向、轻盈、流畅的艺术签名。可以高度压缩中文字形，并让多个字符共享笔画、自然连写，通过一至两条大跨度长线或拖尾把整个姓名连接为完整手势。允许牺牲部分可读性，重点表现流动节奏、速度感和优雅气质。

最终效果应像艺人、设计师或创作者自然签出的成熟个人签名，而不是清楚书写的三个中文字。整体以柔和曲线和连续笔势为主，不要堆叠过多尖角。

【锋势款】

将姓名设计成更加锋利、快速、有力量的签名。大量使用斜线、尖角、高竖笔、快速切线和干脆的收笔，把中文字形高度压缩，只保留几个最有力量的骨架结构。

整体可以明显向右倾斜，形成强烈速度感和现代感。避免大面积柔软圆环，让这款和飘逸款第一眼就形成明显区别，气质偏冷静、果断、有气场。

【回环款】

将姓名设计成以大型回环结构为核心的艺术签名。可以使用开放圆环、自由椭圆、大 S 曲线、丝带式曲线或不规则包围结构，把高度压缩后的姓名笔势自然嵌入回环内部或让其穿过回环，并允许最后一笔突破主体结构形成长收尾。

回环必须具有真人快速书写的自然感，不能像规整几何图形。整体第一眼应更像一个艺术家的个人签名符号，第二眼才感受到它来自原始中文姓名。

【极简款】

这是四种方案中最抽象、最克制的一款。不需要完整写出整个姓名，只从中文字形中提取大约 4–6 个最有识别价值的主笔，例如长横、主竖、折笔、斜线或几个点笔，再重新组合成一个高级、容易记忆的个人视觉标记。

最终效果可以接近 Personal Mark、个人 Logo 或设计师签名。第一眼不要求直接认出完整姓名，但知道原始姓名以后，应能够理解这些笔势与原字结构的关系。保持大量留白，不要添加无关圆圈、箭头、星形或其他装饰符号。

【整体控制】

四款签名必须真正体现不同的人格：飘逸款强调柔长、流动和速度；锋势款强调锐利、力量和斜向结构；回环款强调艺术性、包围关系和图形感；极简款强调省笔、符号化和个人品牌感。

不要让四款只是同一种签名修改尾笔。最终签名既要具有艺术性和明显风格差异，也应保留真实手写感与一定的实际书写可能性。整张画面保持干净、高级、有编辑设计感，不添加 Logo、水印、编号、四角星芒、复杂边框或其他多余装饰元素。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【海报主题】
【主标题】
【核心大色域】
【大色域结构】
【主色调】
【微型文化场景】
【核心动作】
【文化器物】
【活动信息】
【画幅比例】
9:16 竖版

设计一张现代东方文化活动海报，以「纸纤维 + 大色域结构 + 主动留白 + 微型文化场景」为核心。

背景使用暖象牙白手工纸，保留约 45%–60% 留白。使用【核心大色域】建立第一视觉主体，并根据【大色域结构】形成纤维束、螺旋、薄片、正负形、穿插、嵌套或其他清晰的大形关系。远看先看到构图方法，近看才发现它与【海报主题】中的真实工艺或材料相关。

大色域具有明显天然纸纤维、纸浆颗粒、水彩或矿物颜料沉积、自然毛边和哑光质感。整体使用【主色调】，颜色低饱和但完整、有浓度，不做脏旧、褪色、随机斑驳、强噪点和数字渐变。

在大色域附近加入非常小的【微型文化场景】，人物正在真实完成【核心动作】，人物、工具和【文化器物】整体只占约 3%–5%，不做商品陈列。

人物统一采用二维纸本淡彩插画画法：五官极简、轻体积、完整平面色块、少量连续衣褶线，不出现摄影皮肤、3D 微缩模型感、CGI 光影、强投影或真实景深。

微场景与巨大主视觉之间加入一处真实来源的“尺度连接”，例如纤维、旋转轨迹、薄箔边缘、印迹、定位线或材料本身，让小人物正在处理的材料视觉上延展成巨大色域结构。连接必须有明确起点和终点，不漂浮、不机械重复同一种曲线。

主标题【主标题】使用小尺度现代宋体或明朝体，放在留白区域；英文类别、日期、地点和【活动信息】使用更小字号克制排版。所有文字必须具有真实意义。

整体阅读顺序为：

留白与大色域 → 大形结构 → 材料质感 → 微型文化场景 → 工艺动作 → 标题与活动信息。

最终呈现远看大形清楚、近看纸纤维丰富、有文化叙事和材料细节的现代东方编辑海报。

避免巨大标题、普通国风插画、写实人物、3D 微缩模型、摄影背景、PPT 网格、商业广告感、脏旧纸张、随机噪点、CGI、玻璃或镜面材质、Logo、水印、编号和星芒装饰。

prompts.text:
提示词：

【海报主题】
【主标题】
【核心大色域】
【结构方式】
【主色调】
【微型文化场景】
【人物动作】
【文化器物】
【活动信息】
【画幅比例】

设计一张现代东方文化活动海报，以「纸纤维 + 大色域 + 主动留白 + 微型文化场景」为核心。

背景使用温润的暖象牙白手工纸，保留约 45%–60% 大面积留白。使用【核心大色域】建立第一视觉，根据【结构方式】形成清楚、有方法感的大形关系，可以通过纤维放射、纸面镂空、裂缝连接、正负形转换或拓印痕迹表达主题，但不要直接做成普通写实物体。

大色域具有明显天然纸纤维、纸浆颗粒、水彩或矿物颜料沉积、自然毛边和哑光质感。整体采用【主色调】，颜色低饱和但完整、有浓度，远看首先看到大形和色彩关系，近看才发现材料细节。

在大色域附近加入尺度很小的【微型文化场景】，人物正在真实完成【人物动作】，人物、工具和【文化器物】整体只占约 3%–5%，不做摆拍或商品陈列。

人物统一采用二维纸本淡彩插画画法：五官简洁、轻体积、完整平面色块、少量连续衣褶线，与纸张和色域属于同一个视觉世界。避免摄影真人感、3D 微缩模型、CGI 光影、强投影和真实景深。

微型场景与巨大主视觉之间建立一处真实的尺度连接，例如纤维、纸屑、裂隙、锔钉、墨迹、工具轨迹或材料本身，让“小手工动作”自然延展成“大色域结构”。

主标题【主标题】使用小尺度现代宋体或明朝体，放在留白区域；日期、地点和【活动信息】使用更小字号克制排版。文字不抢主视觉，不加入无意义占位词。

整体阅读顺序为：

留白与大色域 → 结构关系 → 纸纤维质感 → 微型文化场景 → 工艺动作 → 标题与活动信息。

最终呈现远看抓眼、近看有纸感、有细节、有文化故事的东方编辑海报。

避免巨大标题、普通国风插画、写实人物、3D 微缩模型、摄影背景、PPT 网格、商业广告感、脏旧纸张、随机噪点、CGI、玻璃或镜面材质、Logo、水印、编号和星芒装饰。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Prompt:

【主题】：
【主视觉对象】：
【中文核心字】：
【中文标题】：
【英文标题】：
【主体特性】：展开 / 垂落 / 翻卷 / 分层 / 振动 / 投影 / 反射 / 其他
【档案信息】：结构 / 材料 / 尺寸 / 过程 / 局部样本 / 其他
【主题色】：
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有成熟 East Asian Editorial Design、Museum Poster 与文化出版物质感的竖版海报。

采用“非均衡三分构图”，让画面分别承担主视觉、标题文字和辅助档案信息，但不要平均切成三个区域，也不要出现明显分栏。

先分析【主视觉对象】最有辨识度的真实物理或材质特性，再让这种特性直接决定构图。例如展开产生放射、布料垂落与翻卷形成纵深、材料切面揭示内部层次、琴弦振动形成连续轨迹。不要机械套用案例，应根据当前对象重新寻找最合适的视觉动作。

主体必须占据较大的视觉权重，并跨越至少两个区域。通过遮挡、穿插、投影、翻卷、剖面、延伸、振动或其他真实空间关系，把主视觉、Typography 与信息区连接起来，而不是把三部分分别摆放。

设置一个醒目的【中文核心字】，使用现代高对比宋体 / 明朝体，使文字本身成为构图的一部分。允许主体穿过文字、文字跨越不同材质后发生黑白反转、影子覆盖文字或结构线进入字形负空间，但始终保证核心字清晰可读。

整体使用暖象牙色未涂布艺术纸作为基底，搭配墨黑文字和一个主要【主题色】。每张作品尽量只保留一个强强调色，纸张具有轻微纤维与哑光印刷质感，保持干净，不做严重旧化。

加入与主题真实相关的【档案信息】，例如材料、结构剖面、制作过程、尺寸、运动状态、局部微距或时间记录。小信息使用 Grotesk / Monospace，英文标题使用 Serif。所有文字都应服务作品主题，不使用 Design Study、Visual System、Vol.、Case 等模板占位词。

信息密度保持中高，但不要平均铺满。主视觉形成高密区，结构与档案形成中密区，同时保留约 20%–30% 有效留白，形成明显的密疏节奏。

最终阅读顺序：第一眼看到巨大主体与核心中文；第二眼发现主体跨区形成的空间或运动关系；第三眼理解结构、材料或制作过程；第四眼阅读作品标题和档案细节。

同系列统一纸张、字体体系、信息层级与编辑气质，但每张根据不同【主体特性】重新设计三分方向、视觉动势和跨区方式，不做模板换皮。

避免：平均三栏、PPT 感、普通产品摆拍、满版图片加标题、随机小字、无意义英文、科技 HUD、过度做旧、Logo、二维码、编号和版权标识。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Just landed and setting up camp. This is paradise.

Prompt: **Photorealistic vertical 2:3 photo of a woman (using the uploaded photo as the appearance reference).**

Create a photorealistic vertical photograph in 2:3 format in the style of a casual hiking snapshot taken while resting outdoors. She is not wearing glasses, including sunglasses.

She wears a loose grey long-sleeve shirt with a subtle rectangular print on the chest, dark blue hiking pants, and brown-grey boots with thick treaded soles. On her head is a dark blue baseball cap with a colorful Red Bull logo. She has bracelets on her wrist and rings on her fingers. Clothing shows natural folds, with no glossy finish or staged neatness.

She sits in a low folding camping chair in the right half of the frame, leaning back relaxed. Her legs are stretched diagonally toward the lower-left edge, feet close to the lens so the soles are clearly visible. Elbows are bent; both hands near her stomach hold a small piece of camping gear. Her head is slightly tilted toward her hands. The pose is natural and unposed.

Around her is a wide rocky clearing covered in fine grey gravel. In the background on the left stands a small grey-black single-engine high-wing plane with red accents, large wheels, and a tail wheel, nose pointing left. Between her and the plane lies camping gear: orange dry bags, dark bags, an open red-grey bag, rolled mats, and pads. In the left foreground are a grey sack, blue fabric, and a drink can; on the right, partially cropped by the frame edge, is a large light-grey backpack with dark straps. Behind the plane is dense coniferous forest, with a mountain slope visible above.

Composition is diagonal, with emphasis on the extended legs and chair. The bottom is full of textured gravel; the plane sits in the upper-left area; the forest fills the top of the frame. Framing feels lively and slightly casual, like a travel companion’s photo.

Bright direct daytime sunlight from the upper left creates clear natural shadows under the chair, boots, and gear. The cap brim casts a shadow; clothing and stones are unevenly lit. Colors are natural: cool grey stones, dark green forest, blue pants, and bright orange-red gear accents. No cinematic color grading.

Shot from a low height, roughly at the level of a seated person, with a 28–35 mm full-frame equivalent lens. The nearby boots look larger due to perspective but without excessive distortion. Sufficient depth of field keeps her, the gear, the plane, and the forest distinguishable. Natural textures on fabric, rubber, and stones; correct hand anatomy and natural proportions. No artificial bokeh, studio light, excessive HDR, retouching, or generation artifacts.

Colors, typography, materials, textures, photography style…

Everything started coming together on the same canvas.

This gave me a clear visual system to guide every asset I created next — and keep the entire project consistent. ↓

Create a premium editorial food poster where real food physically interacts with and reshapes oversized typography, using a warm cream or ivory background, bold black Heavy Grotesk typography, photorealistic food materials, generous negative space, and a broken editorial grid inspired by high-end European café branding and contemporary magazine design.

The food must not simply overlap or sit beside the letters, treat the typography and food as objects inside the same physical world, the selected interaction must visibly change the structure of the letters through believable physics.

Examples: PRESS, food weight compresses and locally deforms the typography; SCOOP, a real scoop removes material directly from a letter, leaving a matching cavity and revealing edible material inside; SMEAR, a knife drags food across the type, causing localized lateral stretching and shear only along the contact zone; LAYER, the typography contains real food layers, and one structural layer is physically pulled out and offset.

Keep the interaction localized, clear, and physically believable, untouched parts of the typography should remain hard, clean, geometric, and readable, use only one main physical mechanism per poster, avoid random liquify effects, decorative overlap, generic 3D lettering, or digital-looking distortion.

Add small editorial information such as [INGREDIENTS], [OPENING HOURS], and [ADDRESS], use strong scale contrast rather than traditional menu rows, avoid long horizontal divider lines, boxed prices, rigid bottom information bars, or template-like layouts.

Use bold Grotesk Sans Serif for the main typography, high-contrast Editorial Serif or Italic Serif for product names, quotes, or prices, keep the color system minimal with a cream background, black typography, natural food colors, and one accent color.

The final poster should feel clever, physical, premium, and instantly understandable at thumbnail size, the key idea is simple: food does not decorate the typography, food physically changes it.

Create a vertical 9:16 "Name to Signature" design sheet that transforms one plain English name into four clearly different handwritten signature concepts.

Use two sections. The top 40% shows the original typed name, and the bottom 60% shows four signature designs.

For the top section, use the selected muted background color with subtle paper or fabric texture and a soft natural shadow. Add small widely spaced text at the top:

NAME TO SIGNATURE

Display the original name in the center using a large, clean neutral sans-serif font such as Helvetica, Arial, Inter, or a similar modern typeface. This must look like normal typed text, not handwriting. Keep the layout minimal and do not add extra slogans or decorative copy.

For the bottom section, use a warm ivory paper background with very subtle grain. Divide it into a clean 2×2 grid using faint thin dashed lines, with no outer border.

Create four large black handwritten signatures for the same name. They must be noticeably different in silhouette, rhythm, stroke direction, abstraction, and personality. Do not simply generate four similar cursive versions.

Use realistic gel pen or fountain pen handwriting with natural pressure variation, lighter entry strokes, stronger main strokes, tapered endings, and slight ink irregularity. Letters may merge, stretch, overlap, simplify, share strokes, or become partially abstract. The goal is signature design, not perfect letter-by-letter readability.

FLOW: Create a graceful, fluid signature with smooth connected strokes and one or two long sweeping tails. Keep it elegant, natural, and believable as a real personal signature.

EDGE: Create a sharper, more directional signature using stronger slant, tall vertical accents, pointed turns, crossings, and decisive endings. Make it modern, confident, and fashion-forward.

LOOP: Build the signature around a large expressive looping gesture. Compress parts of the name inside or across the loop, and allow one stroke to extend outward as a strong finishing motion. Keep the loop organic and handwritten rather than geometrically perfect.

MARK: Create the most minimal and abstract version. Reduce the name to approximately 4–6 important strokes, often using the initials or strongest letter shapes as the foundation. The result may resemble a personal monogram or creator mark more than fully readable handwriting.

For softer or more romantic names, MARK may be replaced with CHARM: a refined usable signature with one subtle personal detail, such as a tiny heart-like terminal or a minimal floral gesture. Keep it tasteful and mature.

The four designs must feel clearly different at first glance. FLOW should feel fluid, EDGE sharp, LOOP expressive, and MARK minimal.

Keep each signature large enough to dominate its quadrant. Do not add extra descriptions under the style labels.

Do not add watermarks, numbering, decorative borders, stars, crowns, excessive hearts, unrelated icons, or unnecessary graphic elements.

9:16 竖版

设计一张现代东方文化活动海报，以「纸纤维 + 大色域结构 + 主动留白 + 微型文化场景」为核心。

背景使用暖象牙白手工纸，保留约 45%–60% 留白。使用【核心大色域】建立第一视觉主体，并根据【大色域结构】形成纤维束、螺旋、薄片、正负形、穿插、嵌套或其他清晰的大形关系。远看先看到构图方法，近看才发现它与【海报主题】中的真实工艺或材料相关。

大色域具有明显天然纸纤维、纸浆颗粒、水彩或矿物颜料沉积、自然毛边和哑光质感。整体使用【主色调】，颜色低饱和但完整、有浓度，不做脏旧、褪色、随机斑驳、强噪点和数字渐变。

在大色域附近加入非常小的【微型文化场景】，人物正在真实完成【核心动作】，人物、工具和【文化器物】整体只占约 3%–5%，不做商品陈列。

人物统一采用二维纸本淡彩插画画法：五官极简、轻体积、完整平面色块、少量连续衣褶线，不出现摄影皮肤、3D 微缩模型感、CGI 光影、强投影或真实景深。

微场景与巨大主视觉之间加入一处真实来源的“尺度连接”，例如纤维、旋转轨迹、薄箔边缘、印迹、定位线或材料本身，让小人物正在处理的材料视觉上延展成巨大色域结构。连接必须有明确起点和终点，不漂浮、不机械重复同一种曲线。

主标题【主标题】使用小尺度现代宋体或明朝体，放在留白区域；英文类别、日期、地点和【活动信息】使用更小字号克制排版。所有文字必须具有真实意义。

整体阅读顺序为：

留白与大色域 → 大形结构 → 材料质感 → 微型文化场景 → 工艺动作 → 标题与活动信息。

最终呈现远看大形清楚、近看纸纤维丰富、有文化叙事和材料细节的现代东方编辑海报。

避免巨大标题、普通国风插画、写实人物、3D 微缩模型、摄影背景、PPT 网格、商业广告感、脏旧纸张、随机噪点、CGI、玻璃或镜面材质、Logo、水印、编号和星芒装饰。

A new prompt structure for influencers in various settings. I tested it with Nano Banana. 

2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 young female influencers in very different settings and heart stealing poses data Coverage = Tasteful { secure :: Bool, opaque :: Bool }     -- no explicit constructor exists (E₂)

data Light = L { key :: Direction, fill_ev :: Float, neg_fill :: Direction, polarizer :: Bool }

legal_light :: Light -> Bool

legal_light l = key l == CamRight && fill_ev l == (-1.0) && neg_fill l == CamLeft

data Histogram = H { skin_peak :: Float, shadow_floor :: Float }

in_bounds :: Histogram -> Bool

in_bounds h = skin_peak h <= 0.92 && 0.04 <= shadow_floor h && shadow_floor h <= 0.06   -- E₃

data Frame = F { aspect :: Ratio, verticals :: Bool, headroom :: Float, cut_joints :: Bool }

legal_frame :: Frame -> Bool

legal_frame f = aspect f == one_to_one && verticals f && headroom f ≈ 0.05 && not (cut_joints f)  -- E₄

forbidden :: [Regex]      -- the negative list, zero‑tolerance

forbidden = [ /underage/ , /nudity|see_through/ , /explicit_pose|voyeur_angle/ , /pornographic_framing/ ,
/blur|low_res/ , /over_smoothing/ , /extra_limbs|bad_hands/ , /text|watermark|logo/ ,
/crushed_blacks/ , /tilted_verticals/ , /cut_joints/ ]

render :: Subject -> Setting -> Photo
render s st = let k = infer s st
in  assert (legal_light (light k) && in_bounds (hist k) && legal_frame (frame k)) $
editorial k

prompts.text:
Prompt:

[Brand Name]: {BRAND NAME}  
[Descriptor]: {BUSINESS TYPE / TAGLINE}  
[Brand Type]: {e.g. bakery, hair studio, ceramic studio, bicycle workshop}  
[Brand Keywords]: {3–5 keywords}  
[Core Visual Ideas]: {people, objects, symbols, or concepts related to the brand}  
[Primary Colors]: {2–4 restrained colors}  
[Header Color]: {main header color}  
[Final Ratio]: 9:16

Create a professionally art-directed Brand to Logo exploration sheet for this brand, inspired by refined Japanese independent-shop identities, boutique branding, handcrafted print graphics, editorial typography, screen printing, block printing, and thoughtful local-business design. The result should feel designed, distinctive, and concept-driven rather than generated from generic AI logo templates.

LAYOUT

Use a strict 9:16 vertical composition. The upper brand-input section must occupy exactly 30% of the total image height, while the lower logo exploration section occupies exactly 70%. Keep the dividing line fixed at 30% from the top regardless of the length of the brand name. If the name is long, reduce the font size instead of increasing the header height.

Divide the lower 70% into four equal 2×2 quadrants using only very subtle thin dashed separators. Keep all four cells equal in size, with no outer border and no A/B/C/D numbering.

TOP SECTION

Use [Header Color] as the main background, with subtle paper grain, handmade print texture, and extremely low-contrast graphic traces inspired by the brand’s visual world. These background elements should remain atmospheric and should never become a full illustration.

Show only BRAND TO LOGO, [Brand Name], and [Descriptor]. Use clean, neutral typography for this original brand input and do not turn it into a finished logo yet. Do not add slogans, paragraphs, fake addresses, dates, decorative badges, unnecessary icons, or excessive microcopy.

LOGO DIRECTION 1 — CHARACTER / PICTORIAL

Create one memorable, concrete brand image using a person, animal, product, object, or recognizable activity directly related to the business. Simplify the subject into a compact logo composition with a strong silhouette, limited detail, restrained color, and subtle handmade print texture.

The image should feel like a genuine brand character or pictorial mark rather than a complete illustration. Avoid anime styling, exaggerated cute mascots, generic stock characters, or overly detailed scenes. Integrate the image naturally with the brand name so the pictorial element and wordmark feel like one identity.

LOGO DIRECTION 2 — EMBLEM / SYMBOL

Create a compact graphic symbol by combining two or three important ideas from [Core Visual Ideas]. Use negative space, shared geometry, overlap, transformation, visual metaphor, or double meaning so the elements become one unified mark rather than several icons placed next to each other.

The design should reward a second look while remaining simple enough to work at very small sizes. Prioritize a strong silhouette, clever graphic relationships, and clear conceptual relevance to the brand.

LOGO DIRECTION 3 — CUSTOM WORDMARK

Turn the brand name itself into the primary logo. Do not place a separate generic icon beside ordinary typography. Instead, identify a few letters with strong visual potential and modify them through cuts, shared strokes, altered counters, extended curves, negative space, structural substitutions, or subtle references to the brand’s core concept.

Only modify the letters that genuinely benefit from the concept. Keep the name highly readable and avoid decorating every character. The final result should feel like a custom-drawn wordmark designed specifically for this brand, with a clear visual idea embedded directly into the typography.

LOGO DIRECTION 4 — BRAND MARK

Create a secondary identity mark appropriate to the business, such as a maker’s mark, workshop tag, studio label, shop stamp, service mark, packaging mark, mirror label, ticket, or another format that naturally belongs to the brand’s real-world context.

Keep the structure restrained, open, and highly usable. Allow subtle handmade irregularity, broken edges, missing ink, incomplete borders, or asymmetry where appropriate, but maintain generous negative space and a clear hierarchy. Avoid rigid generic circular badges, overcrowded vintage emblems, fake heritage details, and unnecessary decorative information.

STYLE & DESIGN CONTROL

Use only 1–3 colors per logo, selected from [Primary Colors]. The four directions should share the same brand world, color logic, and general print character, but they must be visibly different in design methodology. At least one of the four concepts must contain a clear pictorial or character-based image; do not make all four logos abstract, typographic, or monogram-based.

Prioritize strong silhouettes, meaningful visual relationships, custom typography, negative space, restrained color, generous breathing room, subtle print grain, controlled irregularity, and authentic small-business character. The handmade quality should feel intentional and refined rather than distressed for decoration.

Avoid generic leaves, random botanical decoration, luxury serif clichés, fake founding dates, meaningless monograms, stock-vector icons, glossy effects, gradients, metallic foil, chrome, 3D rendering, photorealistic mockups, storefront scenes, packaging mockups, and unrelated decorative elements.

The finished image should resemble a sophisticated logo exploration page from an independent branding studio, showing four genuinely different but visually related directions for the same brand.

Aspect Ratio: 9:16

Create a premium editorial food poster for a modern café, bakery, or restaurant brand.

Use a warm cream or ivory background, generous negative space, oversized typography, photorealistic food photography, and a clean European editorial layout.

The key idea is that the food must actively interact with the typography rather than simply sit beside it.

Use the selected visual interaction to create one clear visual hook. For example, a coffee cup can replace a letter, a croissant can overlap the headline, transparent glass can physically refract letters behind it, melted cheese can become part of the layout, or a missing food slice can reveal hidden text underneath.

Keep the main headline large and instantly readable at thumbnail size. Combine a bold Grotesk Sans Serif with a refined Editorial Serif, using no more than 2–3 type styles.

Build clear hierarchy with: large headline, medium product name, small brand information, price, ingredients, opening hours, or address.

Use only cream, black, natural food colors, and one accent color.

Food should look highly realistic with natural texture, believable shadows, accurate materials, and appetizing detail. Avoid CGI, plastic surfaces, excessive gloss, fake textures, or over-stylized commercial food photography.

Keep the composition clean, asymmetric, refined, and brand-ready. Every text element should feel intentional and meaningful, with no Lorem Ipsum or random filler copy.

The final result should feel like a real independent café campaign designed by a strong editorial design studio, with one instantly understandable food-and-typography interaction as the visual hook.

Accent Color: [COLOR]

Aspect Ratio: 9:16

Create a premium editorial food poster where real food and oversized typography exist as physical objects inside the same scene, using a warm cream or ivory background, bold black Heavy Grotesk typography, photorealistic food materials, generous negative space, and a broken editorial grid inspired by contemporary food branding and high-end magazine design.

The food must not simply sit beside, overlap, or decorate the letters, it should physically affect the typography through believable contact, force, displacement, construction, compression, cutting, or structural transformation.

Examples: SLICE, a real knife cuts through the food and the typography attached to that physical section moves with the separated slice; WEDGE, a food wedge is inserted between independent letter objects and physically forces them apart through pressure; PIPE, edible material is extruded directly into missing typographic strokes and physically constructs the letters; GRID, a real press reshapes the food surface into a three-dimensional lattice and the typography must follow the resulting cell structure, depth, and occlusion.

Use only one main physical mechanism per poster, keep the force path and cause-and-effect relationship clear, all movement and deformation must follow real contact and material behavior, untouched typography should remain clean, rigid, geometric, and readable.

Build the composition with asymmetric placement, strong scale contrast, edge information, small meaningful annotations, and large negative space, add details such as [INGREDIENTS], [OPENING HOURS], [ADDRESS], and [PRODUCT NOTES], avoid traditional menu rows, rigid bottom information bars, long horizontal separators, boxed prices, and template-like layouts.

Use bold Grotesk Sans Serif for the main headline, high-contrast Editorial Serif or Italic Serif for product names, quotes, and prices, keep the palette minimal with cream, black, natural food colors, and one accent color.

The final poster should feel clever, physical, premium, contemporary, and instantly readable at thumbnail size, the first glance should reveal the food and headline, the second glance should reveal the real physical interaction between them.

prompts.text:
Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a NEW 15-second Japanese physical comedy with synchronized dialogue and sound effects. Use the selected aspect ratio.

STORY A lands on a sofa, launching B upward. B lands back, launching A into an overhead beam. B relaxes below while A hangs in stunned silence.
REFERENCES A = the black-haired heroine from @Image 1; voice timbre from @Audio 1. B = the white-haired heroine from @Image 2; voice timbre from @Audio 2. Preserve exact faces, hairstyles, costumes, accessories, proportions and reference art styles. Images define identities, not poses or backgrounds. Audio references define vocal timbre, not scripts. Never replay recorded words or mix the two voices.
ROOM AND STYLE One high-ceilinged modern living room, tall windows, warm evening light and Shibuya lights outside. Photorealistic room, sofa and wooden beam. Hand-drawn 2D anime heroines with clean linework, cel shading and contact shadows. One ordinary two-seat sofa faces the camera. B initially sits on its RIGHT cushion. The LEFT cushion is empty; A approaches it from screen-left. One horizontal wooden beam sits above the LEFT cushion. Establish the sofa, vertical space and beam; keep their positions and scale consistent. Exactly two characters, one sofa and one beam.
BOUNCE CONTINUITY — HIGHEST PRIORITY An exaggerated seesaw sofa: LEFT seat compression rebounds the RIGHT seat, launching B; B's return compresses RIGHT and rebounds LEFT, launching A. Show each landing, cushion compression and the OTHER heroine's launch in the same uninterrupted shot. The receiving heroine stays seated until the cushion pushes her upward. Both launches are caused by the sofa rebound. Exactly TWO cushion-driven launches: first B, then A. Never launch both simultaneously. Both travel vertically above their own cushion. B returns to the RIGHT cushion. A rises above the LEFT cushion and catches the beam. The sofa stays on the floor. Cushion deformation is brief and elastic. No magic, explosions, broken furniture or room deformation. Keep bodies coherent and costumes intact; hair and accessories follow the movement.
0.0-2.0s — SIT DOWN, SEND SOMEONE UP Open in a frontal three-quarter wide shot, with the entire sofa, both heroines and the overhead beam visible. A is already making a short, energetic jump toward the EMPTY LEFT cushion, knees bent and bottom directed toward the seat. She does not dive head-first or land on B. At 0.1-0.9s, A says in Japanese {つかれたー！}, voice timbre referencing @Audio 1, with natural lip sync. At approximately 1.0s, A lands bottom-first on the LEFT cushion. It visibly sinks, then the RIGHT cushion rebounds and launches B straight upward. B's feet lift clear of the sofa; her seated posture opens into a startled airborne pose. A remains on the LEFT cushion and looks up. At 1.2s, B begins a continuous Japanese cry {わーーーー！}, voice timbre referencing @Audio 2, continuing until approximately 2.8s. (Brief relaxed instrumental music, stopping instantly at B's launch.) <Soft landing thump, springy cushion boing, upward whoosh.>
2.0-4.5s — SHE IS COMING BACK Frame B's upward arc and descent toward the original RIGHT cushion, keeping the sofa's geography clear. B's ascent slows, reverses and becomes a faster downward fall. No hovering or repeated flight loop. Her body stays coherent, with arms reacting to the fall. A follows B with her eyes, then notices where she will land. A is still seated on the LEFT cushion. Return to the wide sofa view BEFORE B makes contact. Both heroines and both cushions must be visible.

4.5-7.5s — THE SEATS REVERSE THE JOKE At approximately 4.7s, B lands bottom-first on the RIGHT cushion. It compresses deeply and immediately springs the LEFT cushion upward, launching A. Show B's contact, the sofa rebound and A's departure in ONE shot. B stays on her seat. A rises vertically with her arms reaching upward. A screams in Japanese {わーーーー！}, voice timbre referencing @Audio 1, from approximately 4.9-6.8s. Tilt up following A, then show BOTH hands grabbing the SAME fixed beam at approximately 6.8s. Her upward motion stops at the grip; gravity pulls her into a clear hanging pose. Her feet dangle above the sofa. The beam stays fixed and intact. <Heavy soft cushion thump, stronger boing, upward whoosh, brief wooden grip creak.>
7.5-10.5s — ONE GETS TO RELAX Wide shot linking A hanging from the beam above the LEFT seat and B safely seated on the RIGHT seat below. B looks up once, then quietly leans back into the sofa and relaxes. She has recovered; she does not bounce or launch again. A continues gripping the beam with both hands. She tries to lower one foot toward the sofa but cannot reach. A small leg swing sells her awkward position. No further vocal sounds. Contrast B's comfort with A's predicament.
10.5-12.5s — NOW WHAT? Medium shot of A hanging in the same position. She stops trying to reach down and looks toward B below. Her alarm settles into blank bewilderment. Both hands retain their grip. No fall, rescue, third bounce or additional gag.
12.5-15.0s — THE FAMILIAR FACE Cut closer to A's face, with raised arms and part of the beam still visible so her predicament remains clear. Wide eyes, small pupils, raised brows, slightly parted lips held still: her familiar stunned, uncomprehending look. Preserve her original facial design. A short controlled push-in, then hold the final full second. Tiny shoulder trembling is enough. No speech or mouth flapping. End directly on her silent face.
OUTPUT RULES Only A's opening sentence, B's first continuous cry and A's second continuous cry. Each heroine uses her own reference voice. No narration, improvised conversation, laughter or additional vocal reactions. No subtitles, captions, readable text, logos, watermark, HUD, speech bubbles or end card. No duplicate bodies, identity swaps, extra limbs, fused hands, costume changes or injuries. Prioritize readable cause and effect: A lands → B launches → B returns → A launches → beam catch → familiar face. Avoid extended empty pauses or repeated motion.

Preserve exact faces, hairstyles, costumes, accessories, proportions and reference art styles. References define identity and voice, not poses, backgrounds or scripts. Never merge identities or replay recorded words.

Deserted sidewalk beside Shibuya Scramble Crossing at dusk. One human-scale vending machine stands screen-right, its lower retrieval opening facing camera. A stands beside it; B waits to her left. Payment is already complete.
Photorealistic Shibuya architecture, crossing stripes, pavement, machine, cans and lighting. A and B remain hand-drawn 2D anime with clean lines and cel shading, integrated with contact shadows and reflected light.

One can drops into the tray with an ordinary clunk. A picks it up with her right hand. B watches casually.
Finish the purchase by 2.0s; no walk-up or coin insertion.
(Light, brief instrumental everyday music.)
<Button click, one ordinary can clunk.>
2.0-4.5s — THE MACHINE WILL NOT STOP
Hold a clear three-quarter view including the machine, both characters and the ground.
Immediately after A takes her can, another drops, then several more. The clunks accelerate into a rapid mechanical rattle.
By approximately 2.8s, a continuous stream of cans bursts from the retrieval opening. It fans outward and becomes a rolling avalanche across the pavement.
The machine shudders but stays upright. A and B both react visibly: eyes widen, shoulders recoil, then they turn to flee.
Show the normal output turning into the avalanche without a concealing cut or smoke.
(The music cuts off when the rapid stream begins.)
<Accelerating metallic clunks, mechanical rattle, cascading cans.>

4.5-8.5s — RUNNING MAKES NO DIFFERENCE
Side tracking shot. Both characters run screen-left along the same sidewalk, away from the machine. A still grips her original can in her right hand.
The rolling mass follows behind them, catches their ankles and overtakes them. A dense tumble of cans piles around their legs and torsos.
At 4.7-6.7s, A gives one continuous frightened Japanese cry {わーーーー！}, voice timbre referencing @Audio 1.
At 5.0-7.0s, B joins with {わーーーー！}, voice timbre referencing @Audio 2. Keep the two voices distinct even while overlapping.
They lose their footing and sink into the heap; keep their faces visible.
By 8.5s, both are immobilized up to their shoulders, side by side. Their voices have stopped.

Progress from running to overtaking to burial; no running loop.
8.5-10.5s — SILENCE AFTER THE AVALANCHE
Front medium two-shot. A is on the left, B on the right. Both heads and their raised hands emerge from the SAME settled heap of cans.
The machine's output stops. A few final cans roll down the pile; the metallic roar quickly fades.
A holds her original unopened can just above the heap and stares in disbelief.
B takes ONE loose can from the pile. Bodies remain naturally concealed, with coherent shoulders and arms.
<The last few cans clatter and settle, then faint street ambience.>
10.5-12.5s — THE TINY OPENING SOUND
Cut to a medium close-up of B, her face and the can held just below her chin.
Still buried, B calmly opens the pull tab once with a brief hand movement and synchronized sound.
<One crisp can-opening click and a short "psst.">
The "psst" is escaping gas, not a vocalization.
B's mouth stays closed. She looks quietly satisfied and holds the open can. No speech, drinking sequence or additional action.
Keep the pile visible around her shoulders. No music or comedy sting.
12.5-15.0s — THE FAMILIAR FACE
Cut to A's face, with cans around her shoulders and her original unopened can still visible at the lower frame edge.
Her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression: wide eyes, small pupils, raised eyebrows, slightly parted lips held still.
Her gaze shifts once from the single can to the mountain around her, then settles forward.
Use a short controlled push-in and hold the final full second. No dialogue, scream or repeated mouth movements.
End directly on A's silent face.

OUTPUT RULES
Only A's opening sentence and the TWO assigned sustained cries. Each uses her own voice reference. No additional dialogue, narration, laughter, improvised vocal reactions or voice from the vending machine.
No subtitles, captions, speech bubbles, readable text, logos, watermark, HUD or end card.
No extra people, duplicate characters, mixed identities, extra limbs, fused hands, costume changes, injuries or disappearing can pile.
Readable progression: purchase → overflow → escape → burial → tiny opening sound → stunned face. Each shot adds a development; no repetitive action loops.

prompts.text:
Prompt:

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Food: [FOOD / DRINK]
Headline: [1 SHORT WORD]
Physical Interaction: [TWIST / SNAP / DRIP / PEEL / other physical action]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Product Name: [PRODUCT NAME]
Price: [PRICE]
Aspect Ratio: 9:16

Create a premium editorial food poster where real food physically interacts with and reshapes oversized typography, using a warm cream or ivory background, bold black Heavy Grotesk typography, photorealistic food materials, generous negative space, and a broken editorial grid inspired by high-end European food branding and contemporary magazine design.

The food must not simply overlap or sit beside the letters, treat the food and typography as objects inside the same physical world, the selected interaction should visibly alter the structure, surface, or material behavior of the letterforms through clear and believable physics.

Examples: TWIST, long food elements wrap around, pass in front of and behind, tighten around, and subtly pull selected letter strokes; SNAP, the food fractures along a clear force line and the typography breaks along the same continuous axis with small structural offsets; DRIP, a real liquid or glaze flows over the letters, gradually covering and replacing parts of the geometric type with edible material; PEEL, the surface of a letter is physically removed to reveal a different edible material underneath, with the peeled layer remaining visibly connected and curling away.

Keep the interaction focused on one main physical mechanism, localized deformations should follow real contact, weight, tension, gravity, viscosity, fracture, or material separation, untouched areas of the typography should remain clean, hard, geometric, and readable, avoid random liquify effects, decorative overlap, generic 3D lettering, floating food pieces, or digital-looking distortion.

Use a broken editorial grid with strong scale contrast, asymmetric placement, edge information, large negative space, and small meaningful annotations such as [INGREDIENTS], [OPENING HOURS], and [ADDRESS], avoid traditional menu rows, long horizontal divider lines, boxed prices, rigid bottom information bars, and template-like layouts.

Use bold Grotesk Sans Serif for the main typography, high-contrast Editorial Serif or Italic Serif for product names, quotes, and prices, keep the palette minimal with a cream background, black typography, natural food colors, and one accent color.

The final image should feel clever, physical, premium, contemporary, and immediately understandable at thumbnail size, the first glance should reveal the food and headline, the second glance should reveal how the food has physically changed the typography.
