prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】
【主视觉主体】
【中文核心字】
【中文标题】
【英文标题】
【包围方式】暗边夹景 / 圆周环绕 / 时间边界 / 真实门框 / 其他
【空间关系】透视 / 模糊 / 折射 / 旋转 / 运动拖影 / 层层深入 / 其他
【强调色】
【画面比例】9:16

生成一张具有 East Asian Modernist Exhibition Poster、Japanese Contemporary Graphic Design、Editorial Photography 气质的现代展览海报。核心采用“空间型包围式构图”：不要只依靠文字或边框围住主体，而是利用真实空间、暗部边缘、圆周轨道、摄影裁切、建筑门框、玻璃介质、运动方向或透视结构，从外围向中央建立视觉压力和纵深，让中心自然成为视线落点。包围关系必须有明确前后层次，避免只是平面贴字；可以采用“暗边夹住亮窗口”“圆形主体与环形文字形成轨道”“时间 Typography 从边缘压入摄影”“连续门框一层层指向远处”等方式，让包围本身产生空间感。

先根据【主题】和【空间关系】选择一种最适合的视觉机制。人物或摄影题材可以利用磨砂玻璃、模糊、遮挡和明暗边界形成“外暗内亮”；圆形对象可以让文字沿圆周运行，再用针、杆、手或其他真实物件打破闭合轨道；动态摄影可以让时间、方向和大字从边缘进入，再利用运动拖影把多个区域连接起来；建筑题材可以直接用门洞、墙体、窗框或走廊形成真实的 Frame within Frame。每张只保留一种主机制，不要把圆周、门框、玻璃、拖影全部混在一起。

Typography 必须与空间发生真实关系，而不是浮在图片表面。使用一个醒目的【中文核心字】，允许贴边、局部裁切、反白、被玻璃折射、被暗部吞没、沿圆周变形或与摄影边缘发生遮挡；英文标题可使用 Grotesk、Condensed Sans、Outline Sans 或克制 Serif，并根据空间结构进行横排、竖排、90° 旋转或沿路径排列。大字负责建立边界，中字负责主题，小字只保留日期、地点和极少信息。不要靠大量说明文字制造复杂感。

画面要强化真实的前后层次和空间方向。可以通过明暗、遮挡、尺度差、透视、模糊梯度、反射、圆周运动或连续门洞，让观众明确感受到“外围 → 中层 → 中心 / 远处”的视觉推进。至少保留一处“破框”关系，例如唱针切断圆周文字、人物手部靠近玻璃而更清楚、红线跨出摄影边界、远处色块穿过连续门洞成为最终焦点。破框只保留 1–2 处，避免画面失控。

整体保持现代、克制和高对比。背景优先使用冷白、炭黑、浅灰等中性色，根据主题只加入一个【强调色】；强调色可以用于远处出口、圆形中心、时间节点、细线或局部光源，总面积控制在约 5%–10%。如果使用摄影，摄影本身也应保持统一的灰阶、低饱和或单色体系，不要被商业调色、霓虹或电影特效抢走版式逻辑。

信息密度主要来自“空间层级 + Typography + 主体结构”，不是来自知识模块。中央或远端焦点必须比外围更简洁，至少保留约 25%–35% 的有效负空间。外围可以更重、更密、更黑，中心可以更亮、更静、更空，形成明显的“外密 × 内疏”或“外暗 × 内亮”关系。不要加入流程图、材料卡、小图拼贴、复杂参数或无意义说明，除非它们本身就是主题不可缺少的一部分。

最终阅读顺序应为：第一眼先看到强烈的外围结构与中央空间焦点，第二眼理解包围关系如何制造纵深或聚焦，第三眼发现模糊、轨道、运动、门框或遮挡等真实空间机制，最后才阅读标题、日期和少量信息。整张作品要像真实的当代摄影展、声音艺术展、建筑展或独立文化视觉，而不是普通照片加字、商业海报或信息说明页。

避免：普通满版摄影、电影海报感、赛博朋克、霓虹特效、科技 HUD、复杂频谱、地铁线路图、机械圆框、平均四边框、PPT 排版、过多说明文字、随机英文、Design Study、Vol.、编号、Logo、二维码和版权标识。

肌肤非常白皙、细腻、通透，呈干净的冷白瓷肌色调。脸部、颈部、肩部、锁骨、胸前与腰腹肤色自然统一，带淡淡粉润血色。保留真实毛孔、细小绒毛与自然肤色变化，避免塑料磨皮。

人物身穿米白色短款修身深 V 领上衣，整体保留轻松居家开衫元素，但胸前采用明显的大深 V 低领设计，领口自然向下延伸，展现肩颈、锁骨与较多上胸线条，自然呈现 E 罩杯视觉的丰满曲线。短款衣长停留在腰部上方，画面中自然露出部分纤细腰腹。

人物手指纤细修长，一只手自然拿手机自拍，手机位于脸部侧下方，不遮挡眼睛和主要五官；另一只手可轻触长发、衣领或自然搭在腰侧。身体轻微侧转约 15–25°，肩膀一高一低，姿态自信、松弛，不使用标准商业摆拍动作。

采用 9:16 标准近距离半身构图，从完整头顶拍摄至腰胯附近。完整保留头顶、脸部、下巴、双肩、锁骨、深 V 上衣、双臂主要部分与腰线；画面下缘自然带到腰胯附近，不扩展到大腿中段。人物占画面约 75%–85%。

摄影机距离较近，采用自然手机自拍角度，构图轻微歪斜、不完全居中、留白不均匀，像临时拿起手机按下快门的一张真实生活快照。

整体采用高清人物主体 + 手机动态抓拍质感：人物眼睛和主要五官保持可辨识、相对清晰，同时在发梢、脸部轮廓边缘和手部动作加入适量运动拖影与轻微动态模糊；结合柔焦雾感、低对比、轻微颗粒、自然噪点和局部轻微过曝，形成真实、不精修、不完美的手机自拍效果。

【英文标题】：
【主体特性】：展开 / 垂落 / 翻卷 / 分层 / 振动 / 投影 / 反射 / 其他
【档案信息】：结构 / 材料 / 尺寸 / 过程 / 局部样本 / 其他
【主题色】：
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张具有成熟 East Asian Editorial Design、Museum Poster 与文化出版物质感的竖版海报。

采用“非均衡三分构图”，让画面分别承担主视觉、标题文字和辅助档案信息，但不要平均切成三个区域，也不要出现明显分栏。

先分析【主视觉对象】最有辨识度的真实物理或材质特性，再让这种特性直接决定构图。例如展开产生放射、布料垂落与翻卷形成纵深、材料切面揭示内部层次、琴弦振动形成连续轨迹。不要机械套用案例，应根据当前对象重新寻找最合适的视觉动作。

主体必须占据较大的视觉权重，并跨越至少两个区域。通过遮挡、穿插、投影、翻卷、剖面、延伸、振动或其他真实空间关系，把主视觉、Typography 与信息区连接起来，而不是把三部分分别摆放。

设置一个醒目的【中文核心字】，使用现代高对比宋体 / 明朝体，使文字本身成为构图的一部分。允许主体穿过文字、文字跨越不同材质后发生黑白反转、影子覆盖文字或结构线进入字形负空间，但始终保证核心字清晰可读。

整体使用暖象牙色未涂布艺术纸作为基底，搭配墨黑文字和一个主要【主题色】。每张作品尽量只保留一个强强调色，纸张具有轻微纤维与哑光印刷质感，保持干净，不做严重旧化。

加入与主题真实相关的【档案信息】，例如材料、结构剖面、制作过程、尺寸、运动状态、局部微距或时间记录。小信息使用 Grotesk / Monospace，英文标题使用 Serif。所有文字都应服务作品主题，不使用 Design Study、Visual System、Vol.、Case 等模板占位词。

信息密度保持中高，但不要平均铺满。主视觉形成高密区，结构与档案形成中密区，同时保留约 20%–30% 有效留白，形成明显的密疏节奏。

最终阅读顺序：第一眼看到巨大主体与核心中文；第二眼发现主体跨区形成的空间或运动关系；第三眼理解结构、材料或制作过程；第四眼阅读作品标题和档案细节。

同系列统一纸张、字体体系、信息层级与编辑气质，但每张根据不同【主体特性】重新设计三分方向、视觉动势和跨区方式，不做模板换皮。

避免：平均三栏、PPT 感、普通产品摆拍、满版图片加标题、随机小字、无意义英文、科技 HUD、过度做旧、Logo、二维码、编号和版权标识。

George Washington — Commander of the Continental Army and first U.S. president.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
This was inspired by something I saw on Pinterest. I used it for the founding fathers. I am still working on perfecting the prompt.  There are many styles, like this one: 

16:9, do this for 4 legendary founding fathers:  INPUT: $ SUBJECT

// ── INFERENCE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
OUTER_SHAPE   = extract_recognizable_silhouette($ SUBJECT)
ANCHORS       = infer_signature_features($ SUBJECT, 5)
BEHAVIORS     = infer_behaviors($ SUBJECT, 12)
EXPRESSIONS   = infer_expressions($ SUBJECT, 8)
SYMBOLS       = infer_symbols($ SUBJECT, 10)
GEOMETRY      = infer_natural_geometries($ SUBJECT)
DOMINANT_AXIS = choose_dominant_axis($ SUBJECT)
PALETTE       = { ink: nearly_black_navy, paper: aged_warm_cream,
                  ink_2: dusty_salmon, optional }
GLYPH_SET     = generate_glyph_set(primitives × modes × anchors ∪ behaviors ∪ expressions ∪ symbols)

// ── TEMPORAL STAGES ────────────────────────────────────────────
// We render the FINAL frame. These stages describe how the totem
// resolves from paper field to packed glyph ecology.

STAGE 0 — PAPER FIELD (t = 0.00)
  Warm aged cream paper fills the frame.
  Faint vintage paper fiber texture at low opacity.
  No ink, no silhouette, no glyphs.
  Margins reserved: left and right at 8–12%, top and bottom at 6–8%.

STAGE 1 — GHOST BACKGROUND (t = 0.10)
  Faint oversized abstract circles appear in the background.
  Washed-out brush blocks hint at the compositional zones.
  Ghosted geometric symbols sit at 3–5% opacity.
  All background elements are very low contrast — barely visible.

STAGE 2 — MACRO SILHOUETTE (t = 0.20)
  The subject's outer silhouette is drawn as a large container.
  Elongated along the dominant axis by 1.35×.
  Selected extremities exaggerated by 1.7×.
  The silhouette is immediately recognizable at 3m.
  No glyphs yet — only the container.

STAGE 3 — ANCHOR CLUSTERS (t = 0.35)
  Signature features (anchors) receive their densest glyph groupings.
  Each anchor zone becomes a distinct "region" of the totem.
  Anchor gravity pulls nearby glyphs into tighter clusters.

STAGE 4 — GLYPH PACKING (t = 0.55)
  Forty to one hundred twenty glyphs are placed inside the silhouette.
  Poisson-disc sampling ensures no overlap.
  Negative space reserved at 18% of container area.
  Every glyph is a distinct primitive (triangle, circle, spiral, wedge,
  stripe, dot, zigzag, hook, fork, eye, tooth, loop) rendered in a mode
  (standing, compressed, stretched, sleeping, running, side-profile,
  front-facing, folded, abstracted, symbolized).
  Every glyph reinterprets the subject differently.

STAGE 5 — CURVE SPIRALIZATION (t = 0.68)
  Curves in the silhouette and glyph edges spiralize where curvature
  exceeds a threshold.
  Repeated appendages (legs, fins, feathers, antennae) become rhythmic
  spikes.
  Small facial features reduce to geometric marks.

STAGE 6 — MACRO OUTLINE (t = 0.78)
  The outer silhouette edge is redrawn as a hard ink line.
  Rough analog print quality: slight break, uneven width.
  No double line. No fill behind the outline.

STAGE 7 — SCREENPRINT PASS (t = 0.88)
  Ink applied as flat nearly-black-navy fill.
  Dry screenprint texture: missing ink specks, scratched pigment,
  uneven opacity across glyph interiors.
  Optional dusty-salmon accent applied to ≤ 15% of glyph area.
  Background faint circles and blocks remain barely visible.

STAGE 8 — FINAL POLISH (t = 1.00)
  Paper fibers visible at close zoom.
  Edge print quality verified.
  Silhouette verified readable at 3m.
  Glyph count ≥ 30 distinct shapes.
  Negative space verified at ~18%.
  No logos, no watermarks, no text.
  No photographic fragments anywhere.

// ── HARD CONSTRAINTS HELD THROUGHOUT ───────────────────────────
1. Outer silhouette preserved and recognizable at thumbnail scale.
2. No glyph crosses the outer silhouette edge.
3. Glyph overlap = FALSE; negative space ≈ 18%.
4. Every glyph reinterprets the subject differently.
5. No two glyphs are visually identical.
6. No photographic fragments; purely graphic primitives.
7. Palette limited to 2 inks + cream paper.
8. Print texture mimics mid-century screenprint.
9. Elongation 1.35×, extremity exaggeration 1.7×.
10. Curves spiralized where appropriate; appendages spiked.
11. Three reading levels: 3m totem, 1m ornament, 20cm glyph ecology.
12. No logos, no watermarks, no text.

// ── CAMERA ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Format     : 3:4 or 4:5 portrait
Angle      : flat overhead, poster-framed
Resolution : 8K
Post       : no gloss, no drop shadow, slight ink bleed

Output: one 8K mid-century graphic totem poster, fully inferred from $ Subject.

Prompt:

[Product / Brand]: {e.g. Coca-Cola glass bottle, Starbucks cup, Nongfu Spring bottle}
[Mini World Concept]: {e.g. soda diner, coffee treehouse, mountain sanctuary, water park}
[Main Palette]: {use the product’s recognizable brand colors plus 2–3 supporting colors}
[Output Mode]: Before / after comparison
[Final Ratio]: 9:16

Use the uploaded real product photo as the source.

Create one vertical 9:16 comparison image with two exactly equal sections:

Top 50%: the original product photographed naturally in a real everyday setting
Bottom 50%: the same product transformed into a hand illustrated miniature world

For the top image, keep the product realistic and recognizable. Present it like a casual smartphone photo from everyday life, not a polished studio advertisement. Use natural light, realistic reflections, slight imperfections, and a believable surrounding environment.

For the bottom image, completely redraw the product and the entire scene in a unified hand illustrated mini world style.

Do not keep the real photographic product inside the illustration.

The packaging itself must become the main architecture and structural foundation of the miniature world.

Preserve the product’s recognizable silhouette, packaging proportions, key brand colors, label placement, cap, lid, logo area, and other distinctive visual features so it remains immediately identifiable.

Reinterpret different parts of the packaging as architectural spaces such as:

rooftop terraces, balconies, cafés, shops, observation decks, stairways, windows, bridges, gardens, pools, playgrounds, or other spaces that naturally match the product and brand personality.

Build the mini world around the product’s real characteristics.

Use the flavor, ingredients, function, origin, packaging shape, brand colors, or emotional associations as design inspiration.

For example, fruit flavors may become gardens or slides, water may become waterfalls and streams, coffee may become reading terraces and cafés, and nostalgic drinks may become small neighborhood stores.

Add a few tiny people, animals, furniture, plants, and everyday activities to make the world feel alive.

Every small detail should support a clear story. Avoid random decorative objects that have no connection to the product.

Use clean hand drawn outlines, warm matte color blocks, subtle paper grain, gentle texture, and slightly imperfect handcrafted details.

The style should feel like a polished commercial picture book illustration: playful, warm, detailed, collectible, and visually rich without becoming cluttered.

Keep one clear visual hierarchy:

the product packaging is the main landmark, the miniature architecture grows from it, small characters create life and storytelling, supporting elements remain secondary.

Avoid photorealistic rendering, 3D CGI, plastic toy appearance, LEGO style, realistic miniature photography, excessive logos, random buildings, overcrowded characters, or unrelated fantasy elements.

Keep the original brand identity recognizable, but do not repeat logos or brand names excessively.

Do not add extra titles, captions, Before / After labels, borders, watermarks, or decorative typography.

The final image should make viewers immediately understand:

the same everyday product has been transformed into a complete illustrated miniature world.

prompts.text:
提示词：

【自然现象】：____
【核心汉字】：____
【作品标题】：____
【英文标题】：____
【运动规律】：____
【主色】：深靛蓝 / 灰蓝 / ____
【强调色】：朱砂红
【作品短句】：____
【比例】：9:16

生成一张 Contemporary Asian Editorial Design 风格的文化展览海报。

先提炼【自然现象】最独特的运动规律，再让这个规律直接决定构图。不要只画现象本身。

以巨大的【核心汉字】作为第一视觉，并让汉字真正参与运动：被轨迹环绕、被力量穿过、被雨痕冲刷、被光影切割、从负空间显现，或根据主题重新设计更合适的关系。

统一使用暖象牙艺术纸、深靛蓝 / 灰蓝大色形、极少朱砂节点；中文采用现代高对比宋体，英文使用 Serif，小型观察信息使用 Grotesk / Monospace。

加入少量与主题有关的时间、方向、距离、角度、强度或环境记录，作为第三层细节。信息密度中高但杂而不乱，保留约 20% 有效留白。

同系列统一纸张、字体、色彩与信息系统，但每张根据不同【运动规律】重新设计构图，不做模板换字。

第一眼看到核心力量，第二眼看到运动路径，第三眼发现观察信息，最后阅读作品标题与短句。

避免：普通风景海报、天气 App、科技 HUD、模板文字、满版书法、随机小字、Logo、编号、二维码和无意义装饰。

                Select the middle letter of the word "[WORD]". Extend its stem straight down into the center of the canvas. At the bottom of the stem, draw a tiny silhouette of AI_INFER(an icon relating to [OBJECT]).

    <g fill="#000000">

            Draw the bold letters "[WORD]" warping perfectly to form the top half of the "[OBJECT]". The middle letter seamlessly connects to the invisible mask cutout below it.
        </semantic_directive>

    <!-- RENDER RULE: No shading. No 3D. Execute as a flawless 2-color vector illusion. -->

prompts.text:
Pet Portrait AI Filter Prompt

Use the uploaded pet photo as the source. Create one vertical 9:16 comparison image:
Top 50% = the original pet photo
Bottom 50% = the AI-filtered storybook portrait

Keep the top image faithful to the uploaded photo. Do not repaint, stylize, beautify, or redesign it. Only crop when necessary to fit the layout.

For the filtered portrait, keep the pet clearly recognizable. Preserve its species, breed traits, coat colors, markings, facial features, expression, and the core action or moment captured in the original photo.

Do not simply repaint the photo. Reimagine the pet as a charming hand-painted storybook character based on what is actually happening in the image.

Use the pet’s real activity, expression, clothing, pose direction, and nearby objects as the storytelling cues. Preserve the original little story — for example running with a ball, hiding inside a paper bag, yawning, getting soaked, chewing a plant, or wearing a funny accessory.

You may add a few small playful details only when they naturally extend the original moment. Do not invent unrelated costumes, fantasy props, or completely new scenes.

Use cute, slightly exaggerated character proportions where appropriate: a somewhat larger head, expressive eyes, compact body, and small paws. Keep the pet’s original expression and personality more important than making every character look equally cute.

Render the result with traditional watercolor and opaque gouache on warm white textured paper. Use visible brushstrokes, layered pigment, dry-brush texture, slightly rough edges, and handcrafted color variation. Avoid smooth digital gradients, glossy 3D rendering, anime styling, or photorealistic painting.

Keep the lower portrait clean and visually focused, with generous warm-white negative space around the character. Retain only the props or environmental details needed to tell the pet’s story.

The top and bottom sections must each occupy exactly 50% of the final image.

Do not add text, labels, logos, watermarks, borders, inset images, or decorative frames.

prompts.text:
Prompt : Create a medically accurate, high-resolution 3D anatomical visualization of the [BODY_PART], shown in isolation from a [VIEWING_ANGLE] perspective against a deep navy-to-black background.

Prioritize anatomical fidelity over artistic interpretation. Every visible structure should follow real human anatomy with correct proportions, orientation, spatial relationships, attachment points, articulations, and branching patterns.

Clearly depict [ANATOMICAL_STRUCTURES].

Use semi-transparent tissue layers to reveal important internal anatomy while maintaining a coherent anatomical view. Bones, muscles, tendons, ligaments, cartilage, vessels, and nerves should follow their natural anatomical paths.

Render the anatomy using cool electric-blue and cyan illumination. Use fine luminous lines only to emphasize genuine anatomical structures.

Highlight [FOCAL_REGION] with a localized red-orange glow while keeping the underlying structure visible and recognizable.

Use realistic volumetric depth, subtle subsurface scattering, controlled reflections, soft rim lighting, crisp anatomical edges, restrained bloom, and premium cinematic medical CGI.

Single isolated subject. Clean composition. No labels, text, arrows, logos, watermarks, duplicated anatomy, fictional vessels, invented nerves, extra bones, impossible intersections, or decorative anatomy.

Style: professional anatomical atlas meets futuristic biomedical visualization, photorealistic medical CGI, ultra-detailed, scientifically credible.”

Replace:

[BODY_PART] → brain / heart / knee / hand / spine / shoulder
[VIEWING_ANGLE] → lateral / anterior / posterior / three-quarter view
[ANATOMICAL_STRUCTURES] → the exact structures you want visible
[FOCAL_REGION] → the area you want highlighted

prompts.text:
Prompt:

Create a 9:16 retro-tech editorial poster.

Subject: [DEVICE OR MEDIA]
Headline: [MAIN TITLE]
Secondary copy: [SHORT TAGLINE]
Accent color: [ONE COLOR]

Use a clean warm off-white background with one realistic retro digital object as the main visual anchor. Combine 1990s–2000s technology-magazine aesthetics, Neo-Swiss editorial grids, industrial product manuals, and early-digital culture.

Make the headline oversized and structural rather than simply placed above the product. Let the device, media, cable, tape, disc, cartridge, or flash interact physically with the typography through overlap, transparency, cropping, or foreground/background relationships.

Keep the palette restrained: warm white, black, transparent gray or metallic tones, plus one strong accent color. Add meaningful technical information related to the subject, such as storage data, playback controls, exposure settings, save progress, audio tracks, timestamps, diagrams, small labels, grids, barcodes, and micro typography.

Build clear hierarchy: hero object first, bold typography second, graphic interaction third, technical details last. Keep the layout information-rich but organized, with intentional negative space and a precise editorial grid.

Use realistic plastic, glass, metal, circuitry, screens, buttons, and mechanical details. Add only subtle print and scan texture. The technology can feel retro, but the poster itself should remain clean and contemporary.

Avoid real brand logos, random filler text, heavy grunge, distressed typography, neon cyberpunk, excessive colors, futuristic HUD graphics, sparkle symbols, and generic ecommerce composition.

prompts.text:
Prompt:

TITLE: [poster title]
CONCEPT WORDS: [3–4 related words]
BACKGROUND COLOR: [color]
PRIMARY COLOR: [color]
ACCENT COLOR: [color]
GRAPHIC SYSTEMS: [dots / wave lines / concentric arcs / offset contours / radiating lines]
EVENT TYPE: [sound art / exhibition / live performance / cultural program]
EVENT INFO: [date / time / venue]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a high-end experimental typography poster where oversized English words become the main visual system.

Use 3–4 layered words with clear conceptual relationships. Do not simply place normal bold text and apply textures inside it. Rebuild the letterforms directly from precise geometric systems such as dot matrices, parallel wave lines, concentric or eccentric arcs, stepped contours, offset registrations, radiating segments, and frequency-like line bundles.

Give different text layers different graphic behaviors, then connect them through controlled transitions: dots may stretch into lines, arcs may open into waves, waves may shift or drift, and line systems may gradually realign. The poster should feel like one evolving typographic field rather than several separate effects.

Use overlap, compression, partial cropping, displacement, and negative space to create dense multi-layer typography. Maintain strong density contrast: some areas highly compressed and bright, some medium-density, and some deliberately open.

Keep all dots and lines exceptionally clean, sharp, continuous, and intentional. Smooth curves, consistent spacing, clear endpoints, stable dot shapes, no accidental broken lines, fuzzy edges, random noise, messy moiré, glitch artifacts, or low-quality AI textures.

Use a restrained, high-contrast color palette with one dominant background, one main typography color, and only small accent areas.

Reserve the lower 25%–30% for a refined editorial information section with the poster title, one short concept sentence, 2–3 program items, date, time, venue, and program name. Use clean modern sans-serif typography, multiple hierarchy levels, thin divider lines, and an asymmetric cultural-poster grid.

The final image should work at three distances: a strong abstract composition at thumbnail size, readable layered typography at medium distance, and rich geometric detail up close.

prompts.text:
Prompt:

[Brand Name]: {BRAND NAME}  
[Descriptor]: {BUSINESS TYPE / TAGLINE}  
[Brand Type]: {e.g. bakery, hair studio, ceramic studio, bicycle workshop}  
[Brand Keywords]: {3–5 keywords}  
[Core Visual Ideas]: {people, objects, symbols, or concepts related to the brand}  
[Primary Colors]: {2–4 restrained colors}  
[Header Color]: {main header color}  
[Final Ratio]: 9:16

Create a professionally art-directed Brand to Logo exploration sheet for this brand, inspired by refined Japanese independent-shop identities, boutique branding, handcrafted print graphics, editorial typography, screen printing, block printing, and thoughtful local-business design. The result should feel designed, distinctive, and concept-driven rather than generated from generic AI logo templates.

LAYOUT

Use a strict 9:16 vertical composition. The upper brand-input section must occupy exactly 30% of the total image height, while the lower logo exploration section occupies exactly 70%. Keep the dividing line fixed at 30% from the top regardless of the length of the brand name. If the name is long, reduce the font size instead of increasing the header height.

Divide the lower 70% into four equal 2×2 quadrants using only very subtle thin dashed separators. Keep all four cells equal in size, with no outer border and no A/B/C/D numbering.

TOP SECTION

Use [Header Color] as the main background, with subtle paper grain, handmade print texture, and extremely low-contrast graphic traces inspired by the brand’s visual world. These background elements should remain atmospheric and should never become a full illustration.

Show only BRAND TO LOGO, [Brand Name], and [Descriptor]. Use clean, neutral typography for this original brand input and do not turn it into a finished logo yet. Do not add slogans, paragraphs, fake addresses, dates, decorative badges, unnecessary icons, or excessive microcopy.

LOGO DIRECTION 1 — CHARACTER / PICTORIAL

Create one memorable, concrete brand image using a person, animal, product, object, or recognizable activity directly related to the business. Simplify the subject into a compact logo composition with a strong silhouette, limited detail, restrained color, and subtle handmade print texture.

The image should feel like a genuine brand character or pictorial mark rather than a complete illustration. Avoid anime styling, exaggerated cute mascots, generic stock characters, or overly detailed scenes. Integrate the image naturally with the brand name so the pictorial element and wordmark feel like one identity.

LOGO DIRECTION 2 — EMBLEM / SYMBOL

Create a compact graphic symbol by combining two or three important ideas from [Core Visual Ideas]. Use negative space, shared geometry, overlap, transformation, visual metaphor, or double meaning so the elements become one unified mark rather than several icons placed next to each other.

The design should reward a second look while remaining simple enough to work at very small sizes. Prioritize a strong silhouette, clever graphic relationships, and clear conceptual relevance to the brand.

LOGO DIRECTION 3 — CUSTOM WORDMARK

Turn the brand name itself into the primary logo. Do not place a separate generic icon beside ordinary typography. Instead, identify a few letters with strong visual potential and modify them through cuts, shared strokes, altered counters, extended curves, negative space, structural substitutions, or subtle references to the brand’s core concept.

Only modify the letters that genuinely benefit from the concept. Keep the name highly readable and avoid decorating every character. The final result should feel like a custom-drawn wordmark designed specifically for this brand, with a clear visual idea embedded directly into the typography.

LOGO DIRECTION 4 — BRAND MARK

Create a secondary identity mark appropriate to the business, such as a maker’s mark, workshop tag, studio label, shop stamp, service mark, packaging mark, mirror label, ticket, or another format that naturally belongs to the brand’s real-world context.

Keep the structure restrained, open, and highly usable. Allow subtle handmade irregularity, broken edges, missing ink, incomplete borders, or asymmetry where appropriate, but maintain generous negative space and a clear hierarchy. Avoid rigid generic circular badges, overcrowded vintage emblems, fake heritage details, and unnecessary decorative information.

STYLE & DESIGN CONTROL

Use only 1–3 colors per logo, selected from [Primary Colors]. The four directions should share the same brand world, color logic, and general print character, but they must be visibly different in design methodology. At least one of the four concepts must contain a clear pictorial or character-based image; do not make all four logos abstract, typographic, or monogram-based.

Prioritize strong silhouettes, meaningful visual relationships, custom typography, negative space, restrained color, generous breathing room, subtle print grain, controlled irregularity, and authentic small-business character. The handmade quality should feel intentional and refined rather than distressed for decoration.

Avoid generic leaves, random botanical decoration, luxury serif clichés, fake founding dates, meaningless monograms, stock-vector icons, glossy effects, gradients, metallic foil, chrome, 3D rendering, photorealistic mockups, storefront scenes, packaging mockups, and unrelated decorative elements.

The finished image should resemble a sophisticated logo exploration page from an independent branding studio, showing four genuinely different but visually related directions for the same brand.

Nighttime city skyline. Camera rushes toward a rooftop as ice cubes fly dramatically through the air.
SFX: Ice crack + rising bass.

The girl steps into frame, smiling. She raises her fist as a giant chilled Pepsi can appears in her hand.

On-screen text: THIRSTY FOR MORE?
VO: “Pepsi. Thirsty for more?”
SFX: Signature fizzy pshhh + upbeat final beat.

End Frame: Pepsi logo + THIRSTY FOR MORE

Prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic luxury beauty commercial in 9:16 vertical format, following the provided storyboard EXACTLY in the same order. Keep the BY VERBA Lip Gloss tube, pink packaging, silver cap, proportions, branding and label consistent in every shot. Soft pastel-pink aesthetic, glossy beauty lighting, feminine luxury mood, realistic skin and product textures, cinematic depth of field, smooth elegant camera movement, premium cosmetics advertisement, photorealistic 4K, 60fps. No extra products, no distorted packaging, no changes to the logo or product design.
Scene 1 — 0.0–1.5s | PRODUCT INTRO
Close-up of a feminine hand with elegant manicured nails holding the BY VERBA Lip Gloss tube vertically against a soft pink satin heart-shaped cushion. Warm soft studio light creates beautiful highlights on the pink packaging and silver cap. Camera performs a slow, luxurious push-in toward the product. Keep the product label sharp and readable.
Scene 2 — 1.5–3.0s | TEXTURE FLOW
Smooth transition into an extreme macro shot of the same BY VERBA Lip Gloss tube lying diagonally on a pale pink surface. The cap is removed and placed beside it. Glossy translucent pink lip gloss slowly squeezes from the applicator opening, forming a smooth elegant curved trail. Capture the viscous texture, shine and tiny reflective particles in slow motion. Macro focus, realistic liquid physics.
Scene 3 — 3.0–4.5s | TRENDY AESTHETIC
Top-down camera view. The glossy pink lip gloss is artistically arranged into a tic-tac-toe/grid pattern with multiple small glossy heart shapes around it. Three BY VERBA tubes are positioned naturally across the composition. Camera slowly glides downward while catching sparkling highlights on the gloss. Maintain the clean pastel-pink background and playful luxury aesthetic.
Scene 4 — 4.5–6.5s | LIP APPLICATION
Cut to an extreme close-up of beautiful natural lips against a soft pink background. The BY VERBA Lip Gloss tube is held beside the lips. A glossy layer of pink lip gloss is already visible, making the lips look hydrated, smooth and luminous. Subtle camera movement toward the lips, realistic skin texture, high-end beauty editorial lighting. Keep the product clearly visible beside the lips.
Scene 5 — 6.5–8.0s | PREMIUM REVEAL
A polished silver cloche is lifted upward by a feminine hand, revealing three BY VERBA Lip Gloss tubes standing upright on a reflective silver tray. Use a smooth reveal motion with soft pink studio lighting. The metallic tray and caps create elegant reflections. Camera slowly pushes toward the three products for a premium reveal.
Scene 6 — 8.0–10.0s | HERO SHOT
Transition to a centered hero product shot. One BY VERBA Lip Gloss stands upright on a transparent circular acrylic pedestal. A beautiful translucent golden glossy ribbon slowly spirals around the tube from bottom to top. Small golden crystal-like accents sit around the pedestal. Camera makes a very slow cinematic orbit while keeping the product perfectly sharp and centered.
Scene 7 — 10.0–12.5s | ULTRA CLOSE-UP
Extreme macro close-up of glossy pink lips. A lip-gloss applicator gently glides across the lower lip, depositing a smooth, highly reflective pink gloss layer. Capture realistic wet shine, smooth texture and subtle highlights. Very shallow depth of field, luxurious beauty-commercial lighting, slow motion. Make the gloss look juicy and luminous without exaggeration.
Scene 8 — 12.5–15.0s | FINAL PACKSHOT
Final premium packshot matching the storyboard: two BY VERBA Lip Gloss tubes resting elegantly on a soft pink satin heart-shaped cushion. Soft pastel-pink background, warm sunlight, delicate shadows and subtle sparkle highlights. Camera slowly pushes in toward the products. End on a clean luxury beauty-commercial frame with the BY VERBA branding clearly visible.
Final visual direction:
Pastel pink throughout, consistent product identity, elegant feminine luxury, glossy reflections, realistic materials, smooth transitions

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【主题】
【主视觉主体】
【中文核心字】
【中文标题】
【英文标题】
【包围方式】暗边夹景 / 圆周环绕 / 时间边界 / 真实门框 / 其他
【空间关系】透视 / 模糊 / 折射 / 旋转 / 运动拖影 / 层层深入 / 其他
【强调色】
【画面比例】9:16

生成一张具有 East Asian Modernist Exhibition Poster、Japanese Contemporary Graphic Design、Editorial Photography 气质的现代展览海报。核心采用“空间型包围式构图”：不要只依靠文字或边框围住主体，而是利用真实空间、暗部边缘、圆周轨道、摄影裁切、建筑门框、玻璃介质、运动方向或透视结构，从外围向中央建立视觉压力和纵深，让中心自然成为视线落点。包围关系必须有明确前后层次，避免只是平面贴字；可以采用“暗边夹住亮窗口”“圆形主体与环形文字形成轨道”“时间 Typography 从边缘压入摄影”“连续门框一层层指向远处”等方式，让包围本身产生空间感。

先根据【主题】和【空间关系】选择一种最适合的视觉机制。人物或摄影题材可以利用磨砂玻璃、模糊、遮挡和明暗边界形成“外暗内亮”；圆形对象可以让文字沿圆周运行，再用针、杆、手或其他真实物件打破闭合轨道；动态摄影可以让时间、方向和大字从边缘进入，再利用运动拖影把多个区域连接起来；建筑题材可以直接用门洞、墙体、窗框或走廊形成真实的 Frame within Frame。每张只保留一种主机制，不要把圆周、门框、玻璃、拖影全部混在一起。

Typography 必须与空间发生真实关系，而不是浮在图片表面。使用一个醒目的【中文核心字】，允许贴边、局部裁切、反白、被玻璃折射、被暗部吞没、沿圆周变形或与摄影边缘发生遮挡；英文标题可使用 Grotesk、Condensed Sans、Outline Sans 或克制 Serif，并根据空间结构进行横排、竖排、90° 旋转或沿路径排列。大字负责建立边界，中字负责主题，小字只保留日期、地点和极少信息。不要靠大量说明文字制造复杂感。

画面要强化真实的前后层次和空间方向。可以通过明暗、遮挡、尺度差、透视、模糊梯度、反射、圆周运动或连续门洞，让观众明确感受到“外围 → 中层 → 中心 / 远处”的视觉推进。至少保留一处“破框”关系，例如唱针切断圆周文字、人物手部靠近玻璃而更清楚、红线跨出摄影边界、远处色块穿过连续门洞成为最终焦点。破框只保留 1–2 处，避免画面失控。

整体保持现代、克制和高对比。背景优先使用冷白、炭黑、浅灰等中性色，根据主题只加入一个【强调色】；强调色可以用于远处出口、圆形中心、时间节点、细线或局部光源，总面积控制在约 5%–10%。如果使用摄影，摄影本身也应保持统一的灰阶、低饱和或单色体系，不要被商业调色、霓虹或电影特效抢走版式逻辑。

信息密度主要来自“空间层级 + Typography + 主体结构”，不是来自知识模块。中央或远端焦点必须比外围更简洁，至少保留约 25%–35% 的有效负空间。外围可以更重、更密、更黑，中心可以更亮、更静、更空，形成明显的“外密 × 内疏”或“外暗 × 内亮”关系。不要加入流程图、材料卡、小图拼贴、复杂参数或无意义说明，除非它们本身就是主题不可缺少的一部分。

最终阅读顺序应为：第一眼先看到强烈的外围结构与中央空间焦点，第二眼理解包围关系如何制造纵深或聚焦，第三眼发现模糊、轨道、运动、门框或遮挡等真实空间机制，最后才阅读标题、日期和少量信息。整张作品要像真实的当代摄影展、声音艺术展、建筑展或独立文化视觉，而不是普通照片加字、商业海报或信息说明页。

避免：普通满版摄影、电影海报感、赛博朋克、霓虹特效、科技 HUD、复杂频谱、地铁线路图、机械圆框、平均四边框、PPT 排版、过多说明文字、随机英文、Design Study、Vol.、编号、Logo、二维码和版权标识。

生成一张具有 **East Asian Modernist Exhibition Poster、Japanese Contemporary Graphic Design、Editorial Design** 气质的现代竖版海报，核心采用“对角构图”。不要简单把图片或文字旋转 45°，而是先建立一条隐形的斜向主轴，让主体、自然边界、色域或负空间从一个角向另一个角推进，使整个版面的视觉重量产生明确方向。

根据【主题】选择一种最适合的对角机制：人物题材可以让身体动作从左下伸向右上，以姿态本身形成视觉主轴；极简题材可以让大片斜向负空间成为真正主体，只加入极小人物作为尺度参照；自然题材可以利用海岸线、水面、山坡、光影边界等真实斜向关系切分画面；地形或建筑题材可以用大面积切面、尺度差和留白形成距离感。每张只突出一种主要机制，不要把人物、斜线、色块和复杂透视全部叠在一起。

对角构图应依赖“大关系”，不是小装饰。主体或主要色域最好占画面约 45%–65%，同时保留一块明显的安静区域，使画面形成“密到疏”“近到远”或“重到轻”的方向变化。避免平均 50% 对半切，也不要使用标准机械的 45° 斜线，可以让斜向角度略微偏移，使版式更自然、更有编辑感。

Typography 必须保持稳定，与动态画面形成对抗。中文核心字可以放大、贴边、局部裁切，但保持水平或竖直；英文标题使用 Serif、Grotesk 或 Condensed Sans，小信息使用 Neutral Grotesk。不要让所有文字跟随斜线倾斜。建议形成“图像负责动，文字负责稳”的关系，并允许主体与文字产生一处轻微穿插、遮挡或压边。

整体色彩控制在 2–3 个主要层级，以冷白、暖白、黑、灰或单一高纯强调色为主。强调色可以用于短线、节点、局部标题或主体区域，但不要平均散布。保持现代、克制、干净，减少传统装饰和模板化说明文字。信息密度以中等为宜，至少保留约 25%–35% 有效留白。

最终阅读顺序应为：第一眼看到强烈的对角大形，第二眼理解主体或边界如何形成方向，第三眼发现尺度、负空间和文字之间的关系，最后再阅读标题与少量信息。整体效果应像真实的现代展览海报、摄影专题、文化视觉或设计年鉴案例，而不是普通图片斜着摆放。

避免：所有元素都倾斜、标准 45° 模板、平均对半切、斜向时间轴、PPT 感、满版说明文字、无意义英文、复杂传统装饰、科技 HUD、Logo、二维码、编号和版权标识。

prompts.text:
新中式细线设色，别只拿来画古诗。我用它画了今天的城市：便利店、地铁站、老小区、深夜写字楼。

4 段提示词，一段对一张图，直接拿走。换题材只改“画的是现代城市的日常：”后面那一句。

① 便利店
新中式细线设色插画，画的是现代城市的日常：深夜街角一家亮着灯的 24 小时便利店。用工笔白描的均匀细墨线勾出玻璃门、货架、冰柜和门口的一辆共享单车，线条干净不抖。只在少数地方平涂矿物色：屋檐与招牌用石青、石绿，店内灯光用淡藤黄，门口一个小小的外卖骑手背影用一点朱砂红。其余大面积留白，像宣纸底色，微微泛暖，有极淡的纸纹。店的上方飘着两团传统画法的云纹，旁边一棵团状树冠的树，用同样的细线和青绿设色。构图偏下，上方留出三分之二的空白。不要水墨晕染，不要写实光影，不要 3D 质感。画面里不要出现任何文字、印章、logo 或水印。竖幅构图。

② 地铁站台
新中式细线设色插画，画的是现代城市的日常：早高峰的地铁站台。用工笔白描的均匀细墨线勾出站台、屏蔽门、刚进站的列车车头和一排低头看手机的候车人，线条干净不抖，人物很小。只在少数地方平涂矿物色：列车车身的腰线用石青，站台立柱用石绿，候车人群里只有一个人撑着一把朱砂红的伞。其余大面积留白，像宣纸底色，微微泛暖，有极淡的纸纹。站台上方的留白里飘着两团传统画法的云纹，仿佛屋顶不存在。构图偏下，上方留出三分之二的空白。不要水墨晕染，不要写实光影，不要 3D 质感。画面里不要出现任何文字、印章、logo 或水印。竖幅构图。

③ 老小区阳台
新中式细线设色插画，画的是现代城市的日常：傍晚的老小区阳台。用工笔白描的均匀细墨线勾出一栋六层居民楼的侧面，每层阳台上有晾衣杆、空调外机、花盆和防盗网，线条干净不抖。只在少数地方平涂矿物色：几件晾着的衣服用石青和石绿，一户窗里的灯光用淡藤黄，一只蹲在空调外机上的猫用一点朱砂红的项圈点出来。其余大面积留白，像宣纸底色，微微泛暖，有极淡的纸纹。楼旁一棵团状树冠的老树，楼顶上方飘着一团传统画法的云纹，都用同样的细线和青绿设色。构图偏下，上方留出三分之二的空白。不要水墨晕染，不要写实光影，不要 3D 质感。画面里不要出现任何文字、印章、logo 或水印。竖幅构图。

④ 深夜写字楼
新中式细线设色插画，画的是现代城市的日常：深夜还亮着灯的写字楼一角。用工笔白描的均匀细墨线勾出一座玻璃幕墙写字楼的上半截，一格一格的窗户排列整齐，线条干净不抖。只在少数地方平涂矿物色：幕墙的横向分隔带用石青、石绿，整栋楼只有三四格窗户用淡藤黄点亮，其中一格窗里有一个很小的伏案身影，桌上一只朱砂红的杯子。其余大面积留白，像宣纸底色，微微泛暖，有极淡的纸纹。楼腰处横着一带传统画法的云纹，把楼的下半截遮住，远处一弯细细的月亮。构图偏下，上方留出三分之二的空白。不要水墨晕染，不要写实光影，不要 3D 质感。画面里不要出现任何文字、印章、logo 或水印。竖幅构图。

规律就三条：细线勾形，颜色只给三四处，剩下全留白。

画法参考了 @MrLarus 的新中式古诗系列。

Create a premium editorial food poster for a modern café, bakery, or restaurant brand.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【品牌名称】：{例如：尾巴日和}  
【英文名称】：{例如：TAIL & DAY PET CLUB}  
【品牌类型】：{例如：宠物生活方式品牌 / 花店 / 餐饮 / 书店}  
【品牌关键词】：{例如：温暖、自然、亲切、手作感}  
【核心视觉意象】：{例如：尾巴、太阳、宠物陪伴}  
【主色建议】：{例如：奶油黄、深棕、砖红、鼠尾草绿}  
【顶部背景色】：{根据品牌气质填写}  
【画幅比例】：9:16

请为以上品牌生成一张完整的「Brand to Logo」品牌 Logo 概念探索设计稿。核心不是简单生成四个相似 Logo，而是围绕同一个品牌名称、行业属性和核心概念，提出四条真正不同的视觉设计路线。

最终画面固定为 9:16 竖版。顶部品牌输入区严格占整个画面高度的 30%，底部 Logo 展示区严格占 70%，无论品牌名称长短都不能改变这个比例；名字较长时缩小字号，不扩大顶部区域。底部 70% 再严格划分为 2×2 四个等大区域，只使用非常浅、非常细的虚线分隔，不绘制外围边框。

【顶部品牌区】

顶部只是品牌原始信息的引入区，不是主视觉海报。使用【顶部背景色】，加入极轻微的纸张、和纸、包装纸、丝网印刷颗粒或与品牌相关的低对比暗纹，只增加质感，不形成复杂插画。

顶部只保留三层信息：

BRAND TO LOGO

【品牌名称】

【英文名称】

品牌名称使用正常、清晰、现代的印刷字体，不提前进行 Logo 化、手写化或图形变形。不要加入口号、品牌说明、大量小英文、编号、印章、辅助图标或复杂光影，让视觉重点自然落到下方四个 Logo 方案。

【底部 Logo 展示区】

底部统一使用 Warm Ivory 暖米白纸张背景，只保留轻微天然纸纹。四个 Logo 都需要围绕【品牌类型】【品牌关键词】【核心视觉意象】展开，保持品牌核心一致，但设计方法必须明显不同。

每个 Logo 都应该是一套完整、可以真实用于门店、包装、标签、社交头像、名片或周边商品的品牌标识，而不是完整插画、海报或装饰图。

每个方案控制在 1–3 个主要颜色以内，优先使用【主色建议】。避免高饱和杂色、复杂渐变、3D、金属浮雕、玻璃质感和商业 mockup。

【Mascot｜吉祥物型】

从品牌名称、行业或核心意象中设计一个高度概括的角色或拟人化主体。角色需要拥有清楚的大轮廓和强记忆点，但不要做成复杂动漫人物或完整场景插画。

让角色本身与品牌概念发生关系，例如抱着产品、隐藏在物体后面、与核心植物或动物融合。搭配完整的【品牌名称】字标和较小的【英文名称】，整体亲和、有故事感、适合社交传播。

【Emblem｜意象徽章型】

不依赖完整人物，而是从【核心视觉意象】中提炼 2–3 个最重要的元素，组合成一个集中、平衡、容易缩小识别的品牌徽章。

优先使用负空间、环绕、上下叠合、局部包围或图形共形，让不同元素真正融合成一个标志，而不是简单把几个小图标并排放在一起。搭配品牌字标，形成完整稳定的 Logo 系统。

【Type-led｜字形创意型】

以【品牌名称】本身作为核心设计对象。分析中文字或英文字母中最有视觉潜力的笔画、结构、偏旁、负空间和字母轮廓，让品牌的核心意象从文字内部自然生长出来。

可以进行省笔、共享笔画、延长、切割、局部替换、负空间重构或字形融合，但必须保留基本识别度。

不要在普通字体旁边额外贴一个图标。重点是让“文字本身就是 Logo”，形成更现代、更聪明、更具有专业平面设计感的方案。

【Stamp｜开放式手作印记型】

设计一款具有手刻、版画、店章或包装印记气质的 Logo，但不要使用规整完整的方框，也不要把所有内容塞进封闭椭圆。

使用不完整边界、开放弧线、自然笔触、品牌核心图形或文字共同形成松散的视觉范围。元素可以轻微错位，边缘允许少量自然缺墨和手工印刷不均，让整体具有呼吸感。

Stamp 必须保持清楚的主次关系和充分留白。不要因为追求“印章感”而变得死板、密集或难以实际使用。

四款必须共享同一个品牌世界观、核心意象和基础配色，但不能只是同一个 Logo 换四种画风或四种排版。

不要加入 A/B/C/D 等编号。底部不要添加口号、解释句或多余信息。不要生成包装 mockup、真实门店场景或完整插画。

最终画面要像一张成熟、干净、有方法差异、有真实品牌设计价值的专业 Logo Exploration Sheet。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
提示词：

【中文姓名】：{例如：林知夏}  
【姓名拼音】：{例如：LIN ZHIXIA}  
【顶部背景色】：{例如：深钴蓝、灰调珊瑚、鼠尾草绿、深酒红}  
【画幅比例】：9:16

请将输入的普通中文姓名重新设计成一张完整的「中文个性签名 AI Filter」设计稿。最终画面为 9:16 竖版，上方约占 40%，展示普通印刷姓名；下方约占 60%，展示同一个名字的四种完全不同的艺术手写签名。整体高级、克制、现代、有专业设计提案感，不要像普通字体样张或书法练习纸。

【顶部姓名区】

使用【顶部背景色】作为主色，加入极轻微的纸张或织物质感，并可加入柔和自然的窗影、树影或建筑光影，但不要复杂。顶部中央使用很小、字距宽松的英文“NAME TO SIGNATURE”，中央使用暖象牙白色、规整优雅的中文宋体大字展示【中文姓名】，姓名下方以小字号、宽字距大写英文显示【姓名拼音】。

这里的中文姓名必须保持普通印刷字体，不要手写、连笔或艺术变形，用来明确表现“原始输入”。除此之外不要添加额外标语、解释文案、Logo、编号或装饰图形，保持充分留白，让姓名成为上半部分绝对视觉中心。

【底部签名区】

底部统一使用暖米白色纸张，只保留非常轻微的天然纸纹，不做明显做旧、污渍或强颗粒。使用非常浅、非常细的灰褐色虚线将区域分成 2×2 四格，不需要外边框。每一格只展示一个大尺寸黑色艺术签名，以及下方很小的风格名称：飘逸、锋势、回环、极简。

四个签名全部来源于同一个【中文姓名】，但在结构、方向、节奏、抽象程度、重心和视觉人格上必须有明显差异。不要只是将完整姓名用四种相似连笔方式重新写一遍。允许大胆省笔、合笔、共享笔画、连续连写、拉长、缩写、重构和符号化，不要求每个中文字都完整可辨，重点是从姓名中提炼具有个人识别度的签名结构。

签名使用自然黑色签字笔、钢笔或 gel pen 的真实手写质感，线条带自然笔压变化：起笔较细，主笔略重，转折处有自然压力，快速拖尾逐渐变细，局部允许极轻微断墨。不要生成完全光滑的数字矢量曲线，也不要做成传统毛笔书法。

【飘逸款】

将姓名设计成横向、轻盈、流畅的艺术签名。可以高度压缩中文字形，并让多个字符共享笔画、自然连写，通过一至两条大跨度长线或拖尾把整个姓名连接为完整手势。允许牺牲部分可读性，重点表现流动节奏、速度感和优雅气质。

最终效果应像艺人、设计师或创作者自然签出的成熟个人签名，而不是清楚书写的三个中文字。整体以柔和曲线和连续笔势为主，不要堆叠过多尖角。

【锋势款】

将姓名设计成更加锋利、快速、有力量的签名。大量使用斜线、尖角、高竖笔、快速切线和干脆的收笔，把中文字形高度压缩，只保留几个最有力量的骨架结构。

整体可以明显向右倾斜，形成强烈速度感和现代感。避免大面积柔软圆环，让这款和飘逸款第一眼就形成明显区别，气质偏冷静、果断、有气场。

【回环款】

将姓名设计成以大型回环结构为核心的艺术签名。可以使用开放圆环、自由椭圆、大 S 曲线、丝带式曲线或不规则包围结构，把高度压缩后的姓名笔势自然嵌入回环内部或让其穿过回环，并允许最后一笔突破主体结构形成长收尾。

回环必须具有真人快速书写的自然感，不能像规整几何图形。整体第一眼应更像一个艺术家的个人签名符号，第二眼才感受到它来自原始中文姓名。

【极简款】

这是四种方案中最抽象、最克制的一款。不需要完整写出整个姓名，只从中文字形中提取大约 4–6 个最有识别价值的主笔，例如长横、主竖、折笔、斜线或几个点笔，再重新组合成一个高级、容易记忆的个人视觉标记。

最终效果可以接近 Personal Mark、个人 Logo 或设计师签名。第一眼不要求直接认出完整姓名，但知道原始姓名以后，应能够理解这些笔势与原字结构的关系。保持大量留白，不要添加无关圆圈、箭头、星形或其他装饰符号。

【整体控制】

四款签名必须真正体现不同的人格：飘逸款强调柔长、流动和速度；锋势款强调锐利、力量和斜向结构；回环款强调艺术性、包围关系和图形感；极简款强调省笔、符号化和个人品牌感。

不要让四款只是同一种签名修改尾笔。最终签名既要具有艺术性和明显风格差异，也应保留真实手写感与一定的实际书写可能性。整张画面保持干净、高级、有编辑设计感，不添加 Logo、水印、编号、四角星芒、复杂边框或其他多余装饰元素。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
People always ask me, what's the difference between code and regular text prompts. For starters, pseudocode structures are very versatile. They are also incredible for unique hybrid styles you wouldn't be easily to do with just plain text.

Prompt: 2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4  famous countries: INPUT: $ SUBJECT

// ============================================================
// SEMANTIC TYPOGRAPHY ENGINE

S = research_and_infer($ SUBJECT)

WORD = shortest_recognizable_name(S)

DATE = most_defining_date_or_period(S)

EVENTS = rank_defining_events(S)

E1 = EVENTS[0]

ICON = select_one_immediately_recognizable_object(S)

MOTION = infer_dominant_force(S)

// 
// FIRST PRINCIPLE

DO NOT illustrate $ SUBJECT next to its name.

BUILD $ SUBJECT INSIDE ITS NAME.

WORD becomes:

    landscape
    architecture
    timeline
    diagram
    stage
    machine

simultaneously.

// GLYPH STRUCTURE

Construct WORD in enormous condensed black capitals.

Each glyph is treated as architectural volume.

Within / through the letters:

roads may travel
crowds may gather
objects may protrude
walls may crack
machines may operate
buildings may rise
waves may flow
aircraft may cross
figures may climb
landmarks may replace strokes

// EVENT SIMULATION

Convert E1 into a physical force acting on typography.

EVENT_FORCE = map(E1)

Examples:

explosion      → radial fracture
discovery      → reveal / aperture
revolution     → letters overturn
expansion      → glyphs stretch outward
collapse       → broken baseline
flight         → aerodynamic crossing
migration      → repeated figures traverse letters
invention      → mechanical assembly
war            → impact scars / division
unification    → disconnected glyphs interlock
digitalization → modular pixel fragmentation

The event must alter letter geometry.

// HERO OBJECT

ICON is rendered as a small three-dimensional object
or miniature physical model.

It intersects the typography rather than floating outside.

Possible placements:

inside counter
crossing stroke
balanced on baseline
emerging through fracture
replacing letter segment
casting shadow over type

// IDENTITY MANUAL LAYER

Around WORD place a rigorous corporate design-sheet system.

Include only meaningful construction information:

    cap height
    glyph width
    angle
    trajectory
    timeline
    radial origin
    structural axis
    relevant dimensions

Use arrows and engineering labels.

Example:

        1969
          ↓
   ╭────────────────────╮
   │     A P O L L O    │
   │      ↑       ↗     │
   │ LANDER   trajectory│
   ╰────────────────────╯

Do not overload.

Approximately 6–14 annotations.

// HISTORICAL MICRO-TIMELINE

Along one edge place 3–6 tiny dates or stages.

Example grammar:

ORIGIN ─── DEVELOPMENT ─── BREAKTHROUGH ─── LEGACY

But replace these with actual subject-specific events.

Typography:
    tiny technical grotesk.

// STYLE HYBRID

STYLE =

    International Typographic Style
    × aerospace engineering manual
    × architectural construction drawing
    × museum exhibition identity
    × monumental condensed typography
    × miniature physical diorama
    × mid-century corporate design documentation.

// VISUAL RULES

Background:
    clean white / very pale warm gray.

Primary:
    black.

Secondary:
    one subject-specific accent color.

Optional tertiary:
    muted gray.

No gradients except realistic shading on the physical ICON.

Typography:
    extremely bold,
    condensed,
    monumental.

Technical annotations:
    hairline weight.

Therefore visual contrast:

████████████████
heavy semantic type

───────────────
ultra-thin engineering logic

// SUBJECT-SPECIFIC GLYPH MUTATION

for glyph in WORD:

    if glyph resembles subject object:
        mutate(glyph, subject_object)

    if event trajectory crosses glyph:
        carve_path(glyph)

    if architecture is relevant:
        extrude_into_building(glyph)

    if historical rupture is relevant:
        fracture(glyph)

    if growth is relevant:
        extend(glyph)

    if movement is relevant:
        shear(glyph)

Maintain minimum 85% word readability.

// MICRO-DIORAMA OPTION

Selected portions of letters may become shallow physical
miniatures.

Example:

letter cavity →
    miniature street

crossbar →
    bridge

stem →
    tower

baseline →
    landscape

counter →
    arena / harbor / planet / laboratory

Tiny people or vehicles may populate them.

Keep scale disciplined.

// COMPOSITION

             DATE

   ┌──────────────────────┐
   │                      │
   │  █████████████████   │
   │  █   SUBJECT    ██   │
   │  █████████████████   │
   │     ↗    ↑     ↘     │
   │ trajectory event icon│
   │                      │
   └──────────────────────┘

      timeline ──────────→

All technical content surrounds,
but never visually defeats,
the enormous central word.

// NEGATIVE RULES

NO conventional poster illustration.
NO logo placed above a picture.
NO fake blueprint decoration.
NO arbitrary dimensions.
NO multiple unrelated hero objects.
NO generic typography.
NO colorful comic clutter.

The WORD itself must communicate
what happened,
how it happened,
and why SUBJECT matters.

// OUTPUT

A severe black-and-white identity specimen in which
the subject's name becomes a functioning miniature world,
its defining event physically transforms the glyphs,
a single iconic 3D object interacts with the typography,
and precise corporate-construction annotations explain
the geometry like a lost industrial design document.

Prompt:

Crea un póster vertical 9:16 de diseño editorial para transformar un nombre en cuatro estilos de firma.

【Nombre】{ej. Lucía Márquez}  
【Color superior】{terracota / azul cobalto / oliva / ciruela / ocre}

Parte superior ~40%: fondo de color suave y poco saturado, textura sutil de papel y sombra natural de ventana. Texto pequeño: “DEL NOMBRE A LA FIRMA”. En el centro muestra 【Nombre】 en tipografía sans serif moderna y legible; debajo, el mismo nombre en MAYÚSCULAS con amplio espaciado. Respeta exactamente tildes, ñ y caracteres especiales.

Parte inferior ~60%: papel marfil cálido, dividido en una cuadrícula 2×2 con líneas discontinuas muy suaves. Diseña cuatro firmas negras claramente diferentes para el mismo nombre:

FLUIDA — larga, continua, elegante, con un trazo final extendido.  
AFILADA — angular, rápida, con diagonales, cruces y trazos altos.  
LAZO — crea un gran lazo a partir de una letra real del nombre, como g, y, j o q; no añadas un óvalo decorativo.  
MARCA — versión mínima y abstracta basada en las iniciales y 4–6 trazos principales, como una firma-monograma personal.

Permite unir, reducir, superponer o abstraer letras. Las cuatro firmas deben diferenciarse claramente en silueta, ritmo y personalidad.

Usa tinta negra realista de bolígrafo o pluma, con presión natural y ligeras irregularidades. Estética sofisticada, minimalista y editorial española contemporánea.

Sin marcas de agua, números, bordes gruesos, estrellas, corazones, flores, coronas, escudos ni elementos decorativos innecesarios.

生成一张具有 East Asian Modernist Exhibition Poster、Japanese Contemporary Graphic Design、Editorial Photography 气质的现代展览海报。核心采用“空间型包围式构图”：不要只依靠文字或边框围住主体，而是利用真实空间、暗部边缘、圆周轨道、摄影裁切、建筑门框、玻璃介质、运动方向或透视结构，从外围向中央建立视觉压力和纵深，让中心自然成为视线落点。包围关系必须有明确前后层次，避免只是平面贴字；可以采用“暗边夹住亮窗口”“圆形主体与环形文字形成轨道”“时间 Typography 从边缘压入摄影”“连续门框一层层指向远处”等方式，让包围本身产生空间感。

先根据【主题】和【空间关系】选择一种最适合的视觉机制。人物或摄影题材可以利用磨砂玻璃、模糊、遮挡和明暗边界形成“外暗内亮”；圆形对象可以让文字沿圆周运行，再用针、杆、手或其他真实物件打破闭合轨道；动态摄影可以让时间、方向和大字从边缘进入，再利用运动拖影把多个区域连接起来；建筑题材可以直接用门洞、墙体、窗框或走廊形成真实的 Frame within Frame。每张只保留一种主机制，不要把圆周、门框、玻璃、拖影全部混在一起。

Typography 必须与空间发生真实关系，而不是浮在图片表面。使用一个醒目的【中文核心字】，允许贴边、局部裁切、反白、被玻璃折射、被暗部吞没、沿圆周变形或与摄影边缘发生遮挡；英文标题可使用 Grotesk、Condensed Sans、Outline Sans 或克制 Serif，并根据空间结构进行横排、竖排、90° 旋转或沿路径排列。大字负责建立边界，中字负责主题，小字只保留日期、地点和极少信息。不要靠大量说明文字制造复杂感。

画面要强化真实的前后层次和空间方向。可以通过明暗、遮挡、尺度差、透视、模糊梯度、反射、圆周运动或连续门洞，让观众明确感受到“外围 → 中层 → 中心 / 远处”的视觉推进。至少保留一处“破框”关系，例如唱针切断圆周文字、人物手部靠近玻璃而更清楚、红线跨出摄影边界、远处色块穿过连续门洞成为最终焦点。破框只保留 1–2 处，避免画面失控。

整体保持现代、克制和高对比。背景优先使用冷白、炭黑、浅灰等中性色，根据主题只加入一个【强调色】；强调色可以用于远处出口、圆形中心、时间节点、细线或局部光源，总面积控制在约 5%–10%。如果使用摄影，摄影本身也应保持统一的灰阶、低饱和或单色体系，不要被商业调色、霓虹或电影特效抢走版式逻辑。

信息密度主要来自“空间层级 + Typography + 主体结构”，不是来自知识模块。中央或远端焦点必须比外围更简洁，至少保留约 25%–35% 的有效负空间。外围可以更重、更密、更黑，中心可以更亮、更静、更空，形成明显的“外密 × 内疏”或“外暗 × 内亮”关系。不要加入流程图、材料卡、小图拼贴、复杂参数或无意义说明，除非它们本身就是主题不可缺少的一部分。

最终阅读顺序应为：第一眼先看到强烈的外围结构与中央空间焦点，第二眼理解包围关系如何制造纵深或聚焦，第三眼发现模糊、轨道、运动、门框或遮挡等真实空间机制，最后才阅读标题、日期和少量信息。整张作品要像真实的当代摄影展、声音艺术展、建筑展或独立文化视觉，而不是普通照片加字、商业海报或信息说明页。

避免：普通满版摄影、电影海报感、赛博朋克、霓虹特效、科技 HUD、复杂频谱、地铁线路图、机械圆框、平均四边框、PPT 排版、过多说明文字、随机英文、Design Study、Vol.、编号、Logo、二维码和版权标识。

prompts.text:
Prompt:

[Name]: {e.g. Amelia Rose}  
[Top Background Color]: {e.g. dusty blue, muted rose, forest green, deep burgundy, warm ochre}  
[Final Ratio]: 9:16

Create a vertical 9:16 "Name to Signature" design sheet that transforms one plain English name into four clearly different handwritten signature concepts.

Use two sections. The top 40% shows the original typed name, and the bottom 60% shows four signature designs.

For the top section, use the selected muted background color with subtle paper or fabric texture and a soft natural shadow. Add small widely spaced text at the top:

NAME TO SIGNATURE

Display the original name in the center using a large, clean neutral sans-serif font such as Helvetica, Arial, Inter, or a similar modern typeface. This must look like normal typed text, not handwriting. Keep the layout minimal and do not add extra slogans or decorative copy.

For the bottom section, use a warm ivory paper background with very subtle grain. Divide it into a clean 2×2 grid using faint thin dashed lines, with no outer border.

Create four large black handwritten signatures for the same name. They must be noticeably different in silhouette, rhythm, stroke direction, abstraction, and personality. Do not simply generate four similar cursive versions.

Use realistic gel pen or fountain pen handwriting with natural pressure variation, lighter entry strokes, stronger main strokes, tapered endings, and slight ink irregularity. Letters may merge, stretch, overlap, simplify, share strokes, or become partially abstract. The goal is signature design, not perfect letter-by-letter readability.

FLOW: Create a graceful, fluid signature with smooth connected strokes and one or two long sweeping tails. Keep it elegant, natural, and believable as a real personal signature.

EDGE: Create a sharper, more directional signature using stronger slant, tall vertical accents, pointed turns, crossings, and decisive endings. Make it modern, confident, and fashion-forward.

LOOP: Build the signature around a large expressive looping gesture. Compress parts of the name inside or across the loop, and allow one stroke to extend outward as a strong finishing motion. Keep the loop organic and handwritten rather than geometrically perfect.

MARK: Create the most minimal and abstract version. Reduce the name to approximately 4–6 important strokes, often using the initials or strongest letter shapes as the foundation. The result may resemble a personal monogram or creator mark more than fully readable handwriting.

For softer or more romantic names, MARK may be replaced with CHARM: a refined usable signature with one subtle personal detail, such as a tiny heart-like terminal or a minimal floral gesture. Keep it tasteful and mature.

The four designs must feel clearly different at first glance. FLOW should feel fluid, EDGE sharp, LOOP expressive, and MARK minimal.

Keep each signature large enough to dominate its quadrant. Do not add extra descriptions under the style labels.

Do not add watermarks, numbering, decorative borders, stars, crowns, excessive hearts, unrelated icons, or unnecessary graphic elements.

以【核心草本 / 果实】作为画面主体，搭配【辅助原料】，使用平面化东方淡彩草木插画表现。植物结构清晰但适度概括，低饱和色彩、简化明暗、轻水彩晕染和旧印刷感，不做写实植物摄影或精密博物绘。

Scene 1 (0–3s) – Abstract Beginning
Extreme macro close-up of glossy burgundy patent leather flowing like smooth liquid waves. Soft light glides across curved surfaces, creating elegant reflections. The object remains unrecognizable, mysterious, and luxurious. Slow cinematic camera glide.
Scene 2 (3–6s) – Crafted to Perfection
Macro shots of fine stitching, polished leather edges, precise craftsmanship, and the strap attachment. Close-up of premium gold hardware with subtle reflections. Slow focus transitions emphasize every luxury detail.

A dramatic macro shot reveals the iconic gold logo mounted on the burgundy leather. The camera slowly dollies in as warm highlights shimmer across the polished metal, creating a bold luxury reveal.
Scene 4 (9–12s) – The Reveal
The camera pulls back to reveal the complete handbag standing elegantly against a rich burgundy gradient background. Soft spotlight, glossy floor reflection, minimal composition, premium editorial look.
Scene 5 (12–15s) – Hero Ending
The camera slowly pushes toward the bag as cinematic lighting enhances the leather shine and gold hardware. The background fades darker while the product remains illuminated. End with a luxury brand campaign aesthetic, clean frame, ultra-realistic, premium fashion advertisement.

先分析【主视觉对象】最有辨识度的真实物理或材质特性，再让这种特性直接决定构图。例如展开产生放射、布料垂落与翻卷形成纵深、材料切面揭示内部层次、琴弦振动形成连续轨迹。不要机械套用案例，应根据当前对象重新寻找最合适的视觉动作。

主体必须占据较大的视觉权重，并跨越至少两个区域。通过遮挡、穿插、投影、翻卷、剖面、延伸、振动或其他真实空间关系，把主视觉、Typography 与信息区连接起来，而不是把三部分分别摆放。

设置一个醒目的【中文核心字】，使用现代高对比宋体 / 明朝体，使文字本身成为构图的一部分。允许主体穿过文字、文字跨越不同材质后发生黑白反转、影子覆盖文字或结构线进入字形负空间，但始终保证核心字清晰可读。

整体使用暖象牙色未涂布艺术纸作为基底，搭配墨黑文字和一个主要【主题色】。每张作品尽量只保留一个强强调色，纸张具有轻微纤维与哑光印刷质感，保持干净，不做严重旧化。

加入与主题真实相关的【档案信息】，例如材料、结构剖面、制作过程、尺寸、运动状态、局部微距或时间记录。小信息使用 Grotesk / Monospace，英文标题使用 Serif。所有文字都应服务作品主题，不使用 Design Study、Visual System、Vol.、Case 等模板占位词。

信息密度保持中高，但不要平均铺满。主视觉形成高密区，结构与档案形成中密区，同时保留约 20%–30% 有效留白，形成明显的密疏节奏。

最终阅读顺序：第一眼看到巨大主体与核心中文；第二眼发现主体跨区形成的空间或运动关系；第三眼理解结构、材料或制作过程；第四眼阅读作品标题和档案细节。

同系列统一纸张、字体体系、信息层级与编辑气质，但每张根据不同【主体特性】重新设计三分方向、视觉动势和跨区方式，不做模板换皮。

避免：平均三栏、PPT 感、普通产品摆拍、满版图片加标题、随机小字、无意义英文、科技 HUD、过度做旧、Logo、二维码、编号和版权标识。

[Shot 1] Open on a level full-body two-shot. <Subject 1> stands screen-left and <Subject 2> screen-right, facing each other about three meters apart. Both are visibly the same standing height. A sweeps her right palm toward B. A tall vertical oval of violet-edged darkness opens immediately behind B, its lower edge meeting the ground.

A brief inward gust lifts B's hair and loose fabric. B slides backward through the opening as one intact body, feet close to the ground. Show her crossing its plane rather than dissolving into particles. By four seconds she has completely disappeared. Only then does the portal contract and close. No part of B remains in the courtyard. The SAME <Subject 2> steps forward through this opening, already holding the ice cream and carrying the paper bag on her left forearm. Her appearance and height are unchanged. Show one continuous entrance: head, torso and legs cross the doorway together in a normal walking action. She places both feet on the courtyard floor before the portal closes behind her. There is only one B.
A glimpse of warm golden light inside the portal contrasts with the earlier ominous darkness, but no other characters or location montage appears. B looks relaxed, as though returning from a pleasant outing. Soft footsteps and paper-bag rustle accompany her entrance. The music stops when her souvenirs become visible.

By about nine seconds, B stands within arm's reach of A. Keeping the cone upright in her left hand and the bag on her left forearm, B taps A's left shoulder once with her free right index finger. A turns her head and upper body toward B. B withdraws that hand, reaches into the bag and takes out the single bun in its paper cup. overall_soundscape:
Faint courtyard wind, one banishment rush, the first portal's sealing thump, a softer return-portal shimmer, light footsteps, paper-bag rustle and subtle handling sounds. A speaks only the sentence in Shot 1. B is entirely silent. After three seconds, no dialogue, narration, gasps, grunts, screams, laughter or vocal breaths. A solemn fantasy instrumental with low strings and restrained percussion supports A's opening spell and apparent victory. Stop it abruptly when B emerges with the shopping bag and ice cream. Finish with only quiet environmental and prop sounds. No choir, vocal samples, comedy sting or canned laughter.

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
Kind of reminds me of styles I used to do on Midjourney but this one was done with GPT Image 2.5.

Prompt: 

2x2 grid, 16:9, AI picks subjects: INPUT: $ SUBJECT

// ── SEMANTIC INFERENCE ──────────────────────────────────────────
ARCHETYPE     = infer_subject_archetype($ SUBJECT)        // detective, child, musician, dancer, animal, messenger
MOOD_KEY      = infer_emotional_tone($ SUBJECT)           // melancholic, defiant, whimsical, longing, solemn
STAGE         = infer_storybook_setting($ SUBJECT)        // rain-slick street, foggy forest, train platform, ballroom
LIGHT_SOURCE  = infer_primary_light($ SUBJECT)            // window slats, streetlamp, projector beam, moon
HAZE          = infer_atmospheric_element($ SUBJECT)      // smoke, fog, mist, dust, rain, steam
SYMBOLS       = infer_symbolic_objects($ SUBJECT, 3..5)   // clocks, birds, keys, doors, branches, letters
FRAME_ELEMENT = infer_framing_device($ SUBJECT)           // doorway, arch, window, mirror, stage proscenium
SILHOUETTES   = infer_background_figures($ SUJECT, 1..3)  // distant witness, mirror-self, shadow-self
ACCENT_COLOR  = infer_single_accent($ SUBJECT)            // red, blue, yellow, ember orange, none
PALETTE       = { black, deep charcoal, graphite, silver-gray, paper white, one accent }
TEXTURE_MIX   = { film_grain, ink_wash, paper_fiber, smoke_haze, wet_reflection }

// ── COMPOSITION FIELD ──────────────────────────────────────────
// Subject anchors the center; light rays and reflections radiate outward.
P(x,y) = subject_gravity(ARCHETYPE) + beam_pressure(LIGHT_SOURCE)
F = ∇P                    // primary light ray direction, floor reflection angle
Curl = ∇×P                // smoke curls, water ripples, cloud shape, decorative scrollwork
Div  = ∇·F                // density of symbolic objects, background figures, poster elements

// ── SUBJECT LAYER ──────────────────────────────────────────────
SUBJECT_RENDER = monochrome_figure(
    archetype   := ARCHETYPE,
    pose        := staged_contrapposto or dramatic_gesture,
    silhouette  := clean, readable, theatrical,
    facial_tone := partial shadow — features half-lit, half-dissolved
)
// Subject faces a light source; one side is silver-gray, the other black.
// No full-face realism — expression implied through silhouette and gesture.

// ── LIGHTING SYSTEM ────────────────────────────────────────────
KEY       : single directional beam from LIGHT_SOURCE
            — window slats casting parallel shadows
            — streetlamp halo pooling on wet floor
            — projector cone slicing through haze
            — moonburst through foliage
FILL      : minimal, deep shadow dominant
RIM       : reflective highlight on the floor, silver edge on subject's silhouette
BEAMS     : volumetric light shafts through haze; sharp or diffuse depending on genre
REFLECTIONS: wet floor, mirrored pool, polished surface, glass

// ── ATMOSPHERE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
HAZE_LAYER = volumetric field from HAZE:
    density  : gradient from subject outward
    motion   : drifting, curling, thinning
    interaction: haze brightens in beam, darkens in shadow
    treatment: silver streaks, mist ribbons, ink-wash blots

// ── STORYBOOK FRAMING ──────────────────────────────────────────
FRAME_DEVICE = FRAME_ELEMENT rendered in strong graphic style
    — arch, doorway, window, mirror: purely architectural silhouette
    — acts as a threshold the subject either stands within, moves through, or faces
DECORATIVE_DETAILS around edges:
    — scrollwork corners, hanging vines, tiny stars, floating leaves
    — restrained, not cluttering; each traces to $ SUBJECT's world

// ── SYMBOLIC OBJECTS ───────────────────────────────────────────
for each symbol in SYMBOLS:
    placed at a Div-maximum point
    rendered as silhouette or outlined icon
    some act as foreground depth cues (feet of a statue, top of a clock)
    some act as background narrative cues (distant figure, hanging sign)
    none compete with subject silhouette

// ── STAGED BACKGROUND ──────────────────────────────────────────
BACKGROUND = layered stage geometry
    LAYER 1 (nearest): frame element + foreground props
    LAYER 2 (mid): subject + symbolic objects
    LAYER 3 (far): distant architecture, silhouettes, glowing windows
    LAYER 4 (deepest): fog banks, moon, horizon haze
Every layer separated by tone and haze; no layer fully resolved.

// ── ACCENT COLOR ───────────────────────────────────────────────
ACCENT = single hue applied to one element only:
    — a scarf, a lit window, an eye highlight, a blossom, a lantern
    — maximum 3% of frame area
    — if subject suggests no accent, palette stays pure monochrome

// ── TEXTURE PASS ───────────────────────────────────────────────
Composite pass: film grain overlay (subtle, organic)
Ink wash diffusion on flat tone regions
Paper fiber visible in highlights
Wet reflections rendered with sharp silver streak highlights
Smoke rendered as soft diffusion, no hard edges

// ── CAMERA & FINISH ────────────────────────────────────────────
Framing   : subject slightly off-center, framed by stage geometry
Format    : 4:5 or 2:3
Resolution: 8K
Finish    : filmic black-and-white, no color, no bloom, no vignette beyond natural falloff
Text      : none

// ── VALIDATION ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
verify: subject silhouette reads at 200px thumbnail
verify: primary light source creates consistent shadows across all layers
verify: accent color (if present) appears on exactly one element
verify: no color beyond palette + single accent
verify: no logos, no watermarks, no captions
verify: image reads as a poster, not a photograph
Output: one 8K monochrome noir storybook poster.

提示词：

【核心汉字】：填写 1 个汉字，如「宴 / 市 / 游 / 山」
【主题】：填写与汉字含义对应的古画主题

【英文标题】：填写英文展览标题
【副标题】：填写一句展览说明
【主题短句】：填写一句简短文案
【主色调】：填写低饱和东方色系
【时间地点】：填写展览信息
【比例】：9:16

设计一张「一字一境」东方古画文字重构海报。

以暖米色宣纸或绢本质感为背景，保留大面积干净留白。用一个超大型【核心汉字】作为整张海报的视觉骨架，字形采用古拙书法、隶意或碑帖感结构，笔画具有自然粗细、飞白、断墨和真实毛笔边缘，避免现代规则字体。

不要简单把一整幅古画裁进文字。根据【核心汉字】本身的结构和含义，重新组织【画中内容】，让不同笔画分别承载人物、建筑、道路、山水或器物，使“字形”和“画面叙事”真正发生关系。

复杂细节主要集中在汉字内部，字外保持克制。允许约 5%–15% 的元素自然突破字形边界，例如人物衣袖、花枝、旗幡、马首、水纹、云气、松枝或亭角，让画面产生“字里的世界正在向外生长”的生命感。

顶部或侧边加入超大高对比英文衬线标题，搭配少量竖排中文副标题、主题短句、TIME、ADDRESS 和一枚小型朱砂印章。文字层级清楚，不堆叠无意义小字。

整体使用【主色调】，低饱和、细腻、有古画绢本与现代 Editorial Design 的结合感。最终效果应像完整的东方文化展览作品，而不是普通国风模板。

避免：古画简单平铺进字体、现代粗黑字、素材拼贴、满版细节、过度复古滤镜、高饱和颜色、旅游宣传感、乱码、Logo、水印、图片编号。

Prompt:

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Food: [FOOD / PRODUCT]
Headline: [1 SHORT WORD]
Physical Interaction: [ROLL / TORCH / FOLD / GRATE / other physical action]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Product Name: [PRODUCT NAME]
Price: [PRICE]
Aspect Ratio: 9:16

Create a premium editorial food poster where real food physically interacts with and reshapes oversized typography, using a warm cream or ivory background, bold black Heavy Grotesk typography, photorealistic food materials, generous negative space, and a broken editorial grid inspired by contemporary European food branding and high-end magazine design.

The food and typography must exist inside the same physical world, the food should not simply overlap, decorate, or sit beside the letters, instead the selected physical action must visibly alter the typography through believable material behavior, geometry, heat, pressure, bending, abrasion, or surface transformation.

Examples: ROLL, a continuous food surface rolls into a spiral while the typography printed on that same surface bends, compresses, stretches, foreshortens, and wraps with it; TORCH, heat transforms a real sugar coating on the letters from dry crystals to molten sugar and then amber caramel glass while the black type underneath stays rigid; FOLD, typography printed directly onto a thin food surface follows the same crease, perspective compression, rotation, and occlusion as the food is physically folded; GRATE, a real grater removes material directly from the letters, revealing edible material inside while the removed type becomes realistic shavings and particles.

Use only one main physical mechanism per poster, keep the cause and effect visually clear, untouched areas of the typography should remain hard, clean, geometric, and readable, all deformation should happen only where the food, tool, heat, or physical force actually makes contact.

Use a broken editorial grid with strong scale contrast, asymmetric placement, edge information, small meaningful annotations, and large areas of negative space, add details such as [INGREDIENTS], [OPENING HOURS], [ADDRESS], and [PRODUCT NOTES], but avoid traditional menu rows, long horizontal divider lines, rigid bottom information bars, boxed prices, and template-like layouts.

Use bold Grotesk Sans Serif for the main headline, high-contrast Editorial Serif or Italic Serif for product names, quotes, and prices, keep the palette minimal with a cream background, black typography, natural food colors, and one accent color.

The final poster should feel clever, physical, premium, contemporary, and instantly readable at thumbnail size, the first glance should reveal the food and headline, the second glance should reveal the physical mechanism that has transformed the typography.

Examples: SLICE, a real knife cuts through the food and the typography attached to that physical section moves with the separated slice; WEDGE, a food wedge is inserted between independent letter objects and physically forces them apart through pressure; PIPE, edible material is extruded directly into missing typographic strokes and physically constructs the letters; GRID, a real press reshapes the food surface into a three-dimensional lattice and the typography must follow the resulting cell structure, depth, and occlusion.

Use only one main physical mechanism per poster, keep the force path and cause-and-effect relationship clear, all movement and deformation must follow real contact and material behavior, untouched typography should remain clean, rigid, geometric, and readable.

Build the composition with asymmetric placement, strong scale contrast, edge information, small meaningful annotations, and large negative space, add details such as [INGREDIENTS], [OPENING HOURS], [ADDRESS], and [PRODUCT NOTES], avoid traditional menu rows, rigid bottom information bars, long horizontal separators, boxed prices, and template-like layouts.

Use bold Grotesk Sans Serif for the main headline, high-contrast Editorial Serif or Italic Serif for product names, quotes, and prices, keep the palette minimal with cream, black, natural food colors, and one accent color.

The final poster should feel clever, physical, premium, contemporary, and instantly readable at thumbnail size, the first glance should reveal the food and headline, the second glance should reveal the real physical interaction between them.

日常动作里的危险
prompt⬇️
生成一张 9:16 竖版、超写实纪实摄影风格的女性人像。画面主体是一位 24–28 岁年轻成年东亚女性，成年气质明确，皮肤白皙但保留真实毛孔与微纹理，不做精修磨皮。她盘着蓬松的发髻，额前和鬓边有睡醒后的碎发自然散落，表情平常自然，没有任何摆拍微笑或表演性神态，就是一个早起倒垃圾的真实生活状态。

画面定格在清晨 07:42，老公寓楼道里。她弯腰提起门口的黑色垃圾袋——一手攥住垃圾袋的收口，另一手撑在生锈的金属栏杆上维持平衡；重心落在一侧腿，膝盖自然微屈，弯腰角度真实不过度，像被住在隔壁的邻居随手拍下的瞬间，而不是摆好的姿势。

场景为老公寓楼道——楼梯窗口是唯一自然光源，铁栏杆生锈、墙皮斑驳，电表箱挂在墙面，门口散落着拖鞋，楼道角落里停着一辆共享单车，铃铛磨损发亮，生活痕迹完整而真实。

入口图、五连图、套餐图、推荐菜、菜单图、新鲜事图。

提示词：

【主题】：____
【主视觉】：____
【中文标题】：____
【英文标题】：____
【三分方式】：纵向 / 横向 / 2+1 / 错位
【主色】：____
【辅助信息】：____
【比例】：9:16

生成一张 East Asian Editorial Design 风格的文化海报，使用“非均衡三分区构图”。

不要平均把画面切成三块，而是让三个区域分别承担：主视觉、标题文字、辅助信息。主视觉占最大权重，标题形成明显 Typography 大形，较小区域负责时间、材料、地点、数据、图谱或其他与主题真正相关的信息。

三个区域至少产生一处跨区关系，例如主体越界、巨大文字压图、枝条或结构线穿区、局部纹理进入标题区域，让画面有网格但不被网格限制。

使用暖纸底、黑色文字和一个主要强调色；中文采用现代宋体 / 明朝体，英文使用 Serif，小字使用 Grotesk / Monospace。保持中高信息密度，并保留约 20%–30% 有效留白。

加入一层与主题相关的档案内容，如局部放大、剖面图、时间记录、材料信息或图谱，但不要使用随机英文和模板占位文字。

同系列统一纸张、字体与信息系统，每张重新变化三分方向、区域比例、主题色和主视觉类型。

避免：平均三栏、PPT 感、普通满版图片加字、模板换皮、随机小字、Logo、二维码、编号和版权标识。

prompts.label: 完整提示词
prompts.text:
兄弟，我发现了一个特别容易出神图的海报公式。

真的不是再加几个“高级感、电影感、杂志感”这种废词。

我最近在研究这类复古海报，突然发现它最爽的地方是：

把一幅名画“拆了”，只拿走它最值钱的东西。

不是复刻《雾海上的漫游者》《睡莲》《神奈川冲浪里》，而是只提炼：

巨大英文单词 + 极小人物 + 大面积留白 + Swiss 排版 + 70 年代旧印刷质感。

一下就从“名画二创”变成了真正的概念设计海报。

提示词母版也直接送了，自己替换括号就行👇

3:4 conceptual retro editorial poster, inspired by 【名画母题/艺术流派】 but not directly reproducing it, reinterpret its composition, visual motif and emotional atmosphere as a modern conceptual poster.

Large 【cream / ivory】 negative space on aged uncoated paper, giant uppercase word “【主标题】” in 【颜色】 bold condensed sans-serif typography, interacting with the scene through fog, water, architecture or foreground elements.

Lower portion shows 【重新设计后的场景】 with a very small 【人物 / 小船 / 房子 / 物体】 as a scale anchor, creating a strong contrast between monumental typography and tiny human presence.

Swiss modernist editorial layout, tiny ISSUE / DATE / POSTER SERIES metadata, thin rule lines, small poetic quote, bottom caption and issue number.

Muted 2–4 color palette, 1970s European art magazine aesthetic, vintage offset printing, screen print texture, halftone grain, faded ink, subtle scratches, slight misregistration, aged paper fibers, matte finish.

minimal, poetic, conceptual, museum poster, elegant, restrained, quiet but visually striking.

no QR code, no watermark, no logo, no mockup, no social media overlay, no glossy commercial style, no neon cyberpunk, no 3D metallic text, no clutter
这套东西我越玩越觉得有意思。

AI 画图最怕的是“想画得漂亮”，一旦开始用设计逻辑控制它，味道马上就不一样了。

人物拥有真实东亚女性真人脸，精致小巧的窄鹅蛋脸、流畅下颌线与微尖下巴，五官清冷柔和，眼睛大小自然。肌肤非常白皙、细腻、通透，呈干净明亮的冷白瓷肌色调，带淡淡自然粉润血色，同时保留真实毛孔与细微皮肤纹理。

人物身穿休闲日常风短款深 V 领上衣，采用明显的大深 V 低领设计，V 型领口自然向下延伸，展现肩颈、锁骨与较多上胸线条，自然呈现 E 罩杯视觉；短款衣长自然露出部分纤细腰腹。整体服装以奶油白、浅灰、低饱和粉或柔蓝色为主，简洁、柔软、生活化。

采用明显的高位俯拍视角，摄影机位于人物前上方约 45–60°，从上向下拍摄。人物从较低位置微微抬起小巧的脸看向镜头，形成自然的俯视互动关系。

采用 9:16 近距离半身构图，从完整头顶拍摄至腰胯附近，人物占画面约 75%–85%，完整保留头顶、真人面容、双肩、锁骨、深 V 上衣、双臂主要部分与腰线。避免过度俯拍造成头大身小。

Create a 9:16 high-fashion editorial poster series built around elegant circular framing and direct interaction between the model and the circular form.

The overall style should feel like international fashion magazine covers, couture campaigns, and luxury editorial photography: refined studio lighting, realistic skin and fabric, clean backgrounds, sophisticated serif typography, controlled negative space, and strong visual hierarchy.

The circle should never feel like a simple background graphic. It must become part of the styling, pose, garment, or physical set, with the model actively sitting in it, stepping through it, wearing it, or opening it.

Keep all typography in English, with large fashion-editorial headlines and a small amount of meaningful secondary copy. Avoid logos, watermarks, numbered labels, fake magazine branding, and meaningless filler text.

For this third set, create four independent poster variations under the same visual system:

1. “PLEATED ORBIT” — a woman in a deep burgundy dress stepping through a huge blush-pink circular structure made from radial couture pleats, gently pulling one fold aside as fabric layers pass in front of and behind her body, soft and elegant but visually striking.

2. “SCARLET EXIT” — a woman in a structured black fashion look stepping out through a monumental thick scarlet-red ring, one leg still inside and the other already outside, with direct eye contact, strong movement, clean ivory background, and bold magazine-cover energy.

3. “HALO FORM” — a close-up beauty editorial of a short-haired woman in a minimal black dress wearing an oversized burnished-copper circular couture collar around her shoulders, with part of the circle open so one shoulder and hand break through the structure.

4. “ECLIPSE LOUNGE” — a young man in warm ivory and tobacco tailoring seated naturally on the inner curve of a monumental burnt-amber crescent sculpture, relaxed posture, soft cream background, warm luxury lighting, and a refined menswear editorial mood.

All four images should feel like one fashion story while using completely different relationships between the body and the circle. Keep the visuals polished, elegant, modern, and strong enough to work as magazine covers or campaign posters.

prompts.text:
Create a 15-second action-comedy with synchronized sound. Use the selected aspect ratio. A massive magical fire attack toasts one marshmallow. Spectacular opening; A's familiar stunned face at the end.

REFERENCES
A = the black-haired heroine from @Image 1.
B = the white-haired heroine from @Image 2.
Preserve exact faces, hairstyles, costumes, accessories, proportions and 2D anime art styles. Appearance references only; new poses and background. Separate identities, consistent scale.
Both characters are completely silent. No voice references, dialogue or lip sync.
STYLE AND STAGING
Photorealistic Shibuya crossing at dusk, with realistic asphalt, glass and buildings. Keep heroines hand-drawn 2D anime: clean lines, cel shading, matching lighting and shadows.
Empty streets. Exactly two heroines. A stays screen-left, B screen-right.
One tall, narrow orange fire pillar rises between them, slightly behind their positions, above the lower rooftops. Orange light reflects across asphalt and windows.
B stays outside the fire; her skewer reaches its outer edge. Keep faces and skewer visible.
PROP CONTINUITY
One long, rigid bamboo skewer, held in B's right hand throughout. One white cylindrical marshmallow is firmly pierced at its tip and visible from the opening shot.
Keep the marshmallow attached, unchanged in shape and size. Toasting changes its surface from white to golden brown.
Move skewer and marshmallow together; preserve grip, attachment and length.
Only the marshmallow tip enters the flame's edge. B's hand and body remain outside it.
Shot 1 [0-3s] — WORLD-ENDING FIRE
Start with A already thrusting one palm toward the empty ground. Within the first second, a towering orange fire pillar erupts from that point.
Low-angle wide two-shot: A's serious casting pose, B standing calmly with her skewer, and the enormous flame all remain visible.
Gold-centered orange flames and sparks surge upward. Wind lifts A's hair and costume edges; firelight washes across buildings.
A keeps her mouth closed and looks completely confident. B glances from the fire to her marshmallow.
<Heavy magical ignition, deep rushing flames>
(Ominous instrumental strings and forceful percussion, no vocals.)
Shot 2 [3-7s] — AN ORDINARY USE
One uninterrupted three-quarter medium shot showing B's face, right hand, full skewer, marshmallow and the flame's edge.
B calmly extends her right arm, moving the skewer horizontally toward the fire. The marshmallow reaches the outer edge; her grip stays well away from the flames.
She stops and holds the marshmallow steadily there. Its visible surface begins changing from white to pale gold.
Keep A visible at screen-left, still maintaining her dramatic spell.
B's lips stay closed: calm expression, tiny snack, immense fire.
<Continuous roaring fire, faint toasting crackle>
(The dramatic instrumental score continues seriously.)

Shot 3 [7-11s] — PERFECTLY TOASTED
Close-up of the marshmallow on the skewer, with B's unchanged grip still readable. Its surface finishes turning evenly golden brown, with a few small toasted patches. Preserve its shape and attachment.
Cut back to the medium two-shot. B withdraws the complete skewer from the flame and holds it on her own side.
A notices the toasted marshmallow. Her confidence fades. She lowers her casting palm; the fire pillar rapidly collapses into its original ground point and disappears.
By 11s, the street is clear of fire. Keep the buildings intact and return their lighting to dusk.
Stop the music exactly when the pillar disappears.
<Fire rushing down, one short magical fizzle, then faint city wind>
Shot 4 [11-12s] — SNACK READY
B raises the skewer slightly and admires the perfectly toasted marshmallow with her usual small, satisfied smile. Her lips stay closed.
A looks from the vanished fire to the tiny golden marshmallow.
No eating, blowing, chewing or speaking. The visual joke is already complete.
Shot 5 [12-15s] — THE FAMILIAR FACE
Close-up of A, preserving @Image 1's exact facial design.
Her eyes widen, pupils become small and eyebrows rise. Lips part slightly once, then remain still. Use her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression.
A short, controlled push-in. Hold the final full second with only a tiny shoulder tremble.
No vocal reaction. End directly on A's silent face.
AUDIO CONTROL
Zero character vocal sounds throughout: no speech, narration, inner monologue, grunts, gasps, screams, laughter, vocal breaths, choir or vocal samples.
Specified instrumental music, effects and ambience only. After the fire disappears, ambience only. No comedy sting or canned laughter.
EXCLUDE
Extra people, clones, face swaps, costume changes, realistic character faces, game-CG, chibi, extra limbs or fingers, fused hands, bent or duplicate skewers, detached or duplicate marshmallows, destroyed food, obscured faces, injury, destroyed buildings, subtitles, text, logos, watermarks, HUD, end card.

data Light = L { key :: Direction, fill_ev :: Float, neg_fill :: Direction, polarizer :: Bool }

legal_light :: Light -> Bool

legal_light l = key l == CamRight && fill_ev l == (-1.0) && neg_fill l == CamLeft

data Histogram = H { skin_peak :: Float, shadow_floor :: Float }

in_bounds :: Histogram -> Bool

in_bounds h = skin_peak h <= 0.92 && 0.04 <= shadow_floor h && shadow_floor h <= 0.06   -- E₃

data Frame = F { aspect :: Ratio, verticals :: Bool, headroom :: Float, cut_joints :: Bool }
